am.B: ከዚያም የሞዓብ ንጉሥ የሴፎር ልጅ ባላቅ ተነሥቶ ከእስራኤል ጋር ተዋጋ። እንዲረግማችሁም የቢዖርን ልጅ በለዓምን አስጠራ።
am.R: የሞዓብ ንጉሥ የሴፎር ልጅ ባላቅ እስራኤልን ለመውጋት ወጣ። የቢዖርን ልጅ በለዓምን አስጠርቶ እንዲረግማችሁ ጠየቀው።

decisions.choice: Balak and Balaam: the story of Numbers 22-24
decisions.reason: Balak, king of Moab, was afraid of Israel camped on the plains of Moab and hired the seer Balaam from the Euphrates region to curse them (Numbers 22:2-6).

decisions.choice: fought against Israel: set himself against Israel as an enemy
decisions.reason: Numbers tells of no battle between Moab and Israel. Balak's war was by curse: he hoped a curse would let him defeat Israel and drive them out (Numbers 22:6, 11). The verb is the usual one for fighting, and it treats his plan as an act of war.

decisions.choice: sent and summoned: sent messengers to call him
decisions.reason: Balak sent elders of Moab and Midian to bring Balaam (Numbers 22:5-7).

decisions.choice: sent for; put a curse on / asked him to curse
decisions.reason: "Sent and summoned" is one action, so Balanced and Readable say "sent for".

decisions.choice: Balaque, filho de Zipor; Balaão, filho de Beor; Moabe
decisions.reason: For the whole book: the names in the forms Numbers 22 uses in Portuguese (m1), with "filho de" set off by commas as there.

source.text: וְלֹ֥א אָבִ֖יתִי לִשְׁמֹ֣עַ לְבִלְעָ֑ם וַיְבָ֤רֶךְ בָּרוֹךְ֙ אֶתְכֶ֔ם וָאַצִּ֥ל אֶתְכֶ֖ם מִיָּדֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: And not I was willing to listen to Balaam, and he blessed indeed you, and I rescued you from his hand.

en.L: But I was not willing to listen to Balaam, and he indeed blessed you; and I rescued you from his hand.
en.B: But I would not listen to Balaam. Instead he blessed you over and over, and I rescued you from his power.
en.R: But I refused to listen to Balaam. So he blessed you time after time, and I saved you from his power.

sw.L: Lakini sikutaka kumsikiliza Balaamu, naye akawabariki kweli; nami nikawaokoa kutoka mkononi mwake.
sw.B: Lakini sikukubali kumsikiliza Balaamu. Badala yake aliwabariki tena na tena, nami nikawaokoa kutoka mkononi mwake.
sw.R: Lakini nilikataa kumsikiliza Balaamu. Kwa hiyo aliwabariki mara kwa mara, nami nikawaokoa kutoka mkononi mwake.

es.L: Pero no quise escuchar a Balaam, y él de cierto {{plural_you:los|os}} bendijo; y yo {{plural_you:los|os}} libré de su mano.
es.B: Pero yo no quise escuchar a Balaam. En cambio, él {{plural_you:los|os}} bendijo una y otra vez, y yo {{plural_you:los|os}} libré de su poder.
es.R: Pero yo no quise escuchar a Balaam. Así que él {{plural_you:los|os}} bendijo una y otra vez, y yo {{plural_you:los|os}} salvé de su poder.

fr.L: Mais je ne voulus pas écouter Balaam, et il vous bénit, il vous bénit ; et je vous délivrai de sa main.
fr.B: Mais je n’ai pas voulu écouter Balaam. Au contraire, il vous a bénis encore et encore, et je vous ai délivrés de sa main.
fr.R: Mais j’ai refusé d’écouter Balaam. Alors il vous a bénis à plusieurs reprises, et je vous ai sauvés de son pouvoir.

vi.L: Nhưng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} không muốn nghe Ba-la-am, nên ông ta cứ chúc phước cho các ngươi; và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} giải cứu các ngươi khỏi tay hắn.
vi.B: Nhưng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} không chịu nghe Ba-la-am. Trái lại, ông ta chúc phước cho các ngươi hết lần này đến lần khác, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã giải cứu các ngươi khỏi quyền lực của ông ta.
vi.R: Nhưng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} không chịu nghe Ba-la-am. Vì thế ông ta chúc phước cho các ngươi hết lần này đến lần khác, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã cứu các ngươi khỏi quyền lực của ông ta.

ko.L: 그러나 내가 발람의 말을 들으려 하지 않았다. 그래서 그가 너희를 거듭 축복하였고, 내가 너희를 그의 손에서 건져 내었다.
ko.B: 그러나 나는 발람의 말을 들어주지 않았다. 오히려 그는 너희를 거듭거듭 축복했고, 나는 너희를 그의 손에서 건져 내었다.
ko.R: 그러나 나는 발람의 말을 들어주지 않았다. 그래서 그는 너희를 거듭거듭 축복했고, 나는 너희를 그의 손에서 구해 내었다.

pt.L: Mas eu não quis ouvir Balaão, e ele de fato abençoou vocês; e eu livrei vocês da mão dele.
pt.B: Mas eu não quis ouvir Balaão. Em vez disso, ele abençoou vocês repetidas vezes, e eu livrei vocês do poder dele.
pt.R: Mas eu me recusei a ouvir Balaão. Por isso ele abençoou vocês uma vez depois da outra, e eu salvei vocês do poder dele.

am.L: ነገር ግን በለዓምን እሰማ ዘንድ አልፈቀድኩም፤ እርሱም መባረክን ባረካችሁ፤ ከእጁም አዳንኋችሁ።
am.B: እኔ ግን በለዓምን ልሰማው አልፈቀድኩም። ይልቁንም ደጋግሞ ባረካችሁ፤ እኔም ከእጁ አዳንኋችሁ።
am.R: እኔ ግን በለዓምን አልሰማሁትም። ስለዚህ እርሱ ደጋግሞ ባረካችሁ፤ እኔም ከእጁ አዳንኋችሁ።

decisions.choice: I was not willing to listen to Balaam: God turned the curse into a blessing
decisions.reason: Moses said the same thing: the LORD would not listen to Balaam, but turned the curse into a blessing because he loved Israel (Deuteronomy 23:6). In Numbers 23-24 every attempt to curse became a blessing.

decisions.choice: he indeed blessed you: a repeated verb that makes it emphatic
decisions.reason: The verb is doubled for emphasis: Balaam did nothing but bless. He blessed Israel three times, though he was hired to curse (Numbers 24:10).

decisions.choice: his hand: most likely Balak's power, though it could be Balaam's
decisions.reason: "His" most naturally points back to Balak, the king who fought against Israel (verse 9). It could also mean Balaam, whose curse God did not allow to harm Israel. "Hand" means power.

decisions.choice: over and over / time after time; power
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable show the emphasis of the doubled verb with "over and over" and "time after time", and say "power" for "hand". They keep "his" as the Hebrew does.

decisions.choice: dele (every level)
decisions.reason: "His hand" most likely means Balak's power, but may mean Balaam's (m3). Portuguese "dele" leaves the question open as the Hebrew and the English do; "não quis ouvir Balaão" is the wording of Deuteronomy 23:6 in Portuguese (m1).

decisions.choice: "መባረክን ባረካችሁ" keeps the doubled Hebrew verb at Literal
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the repetition that makes the verb emphatic; Balanced and Readable give its force with "ደጋግሞ" ("again and again"), as the English does.

source.text: וַתַּעַבְר֣וּ אֶת־הַיַּרְדֵּן֮ וַתָּבֹ֣אוּ אֶל־יְרִיחוֹ֒ וַיִּלָּחֲמ֣וּ בָכֶ֣ם בַּעֲלֵֽי־יְ֠רִיחוֹ הָֽאֱמֹרִ֨י וְהַפְּרִזִּ֜י וְהַֽכְּנַעֲנִ֗י וְהַֽחִתִּי֙ וְהַגִּרְגָּשִׁ֔י הַֽחִוִּ֖י וְהַיְבוּסִ֑י וָאֶתֵּ֥ן אוֹתָ֖ם בְּיֶדְכֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And you crossed the Jordan and came to Jericho, and fought against you [the] lords of Jericho, the Amorite and the Perizzite and the Canaanite and the Hittite and the Girgashite, the Hivite and the Jebusite; and I gave them into your hand.

en.L: And you crossed the Jordan and came to Jericho, and the lords of Jericho fought against you, the Amorites and the Perizzites and the Canaanites and the Hittites and the Girgashites, the Hivites and the Jebusites; and I gave them into your hand.
en.B: Then you crossed the Jordan and came to Jericho. The leading citizens of Jericho fought against you, and so did the Amorites, Perizzites, Canaanites, Hittites, Girgashites, Hivites and Jebusites, but I handed them over to you.
en.R: Then you crossed the Jordan River and came to Jericho. The people of Jericho fought against you. So did the Amorites, Perizzites, Canaanites, Hittites, Girgashites, Hivites and Jebusites. But I let you defeat them all.

sw.L: Nanyi mkavuka Yordani mkafika Yeriko, na wenyeji wakuu wa Yeriko wakapigana nanyi, Waamori na Waperizi na Wakanaani na Wahiti na Wagirgashi, Wahivi na Wayebusi; nami nikawatia mkononi mwenu.
sw.B: Kisha mlivuka Yordani mkafika Yeriko. Wakuu wa Yeriko walipigana nanyi, na vivyo hivyo Waamori, Waperizi, Wakanaani, Wahiti, Wagirgashi, Wahivi na Wayebusi, lakini niliwatia mikononi mwenu.
sw.R: Kisha mlivuka Mto Yordani mkafika Yeriko. Watu wa Yeriko walipigana nanyi. Vivyo hivyo Waamori, Waperizi, Wakanaani, Wahiti, Wagirgashi, Wahivi na Wayebusi. Lakini niliwawezesha kuwashinda wote.

es.L: Y {{plural_you:cruzaron|cruzasteis}} el Jordán y {{plural_you:llegaron|llegasteis}} a Jericó, y los señores de Jericó pelearon contra {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, los amorreos, y los ferezeos, y los cananeos, y los hititas, y los gergeseos, los heveos y los jebuseos; y los entregué en {{plural_you:su mano|vuestra mano}}.
es.B: Luego {{plural_you:cruzaron|cruzasteis}} el Jordán y {{plural_you:llegaron|llegasteis}} a Jericó. Los principales de Jericó pelearon contra {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, y también los amorreos, ferezeos, cananeos, hititas, gergeseos, heveos y jebuseos, pero yo {{plural_you:se los|os los}} entregué.
es.R: Luego {{plural_you:cruzaron|cruzasteis}} el río Jordán y {{plural_you:llegaron|llegasteis}} a Jericó. La gente de Jericó peleó contra {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}. También pelearon los amorreos, ferezeos, cananeos, hititas, gergeseos, heveos y jebuseos. Pero yo {{plural_you:les|os}} di la victoria sobre todos ellos.

fr.L: Et vous passâtes le Jourdain et vous arrivâtes à Jéricho, et les maîtres de Jéricho combattirent contre vous, les Amoréens, et les Phéréziens, et les Cananéens, et les Hittites, et les Guirgasiens, les Héviens et les Jébusiens ; et je les livrai entre vos mains.
fr.B: Puis vous avez traversé le Jourdain et vous êtes arrivés à Jéricho. Les notables de Jéricho vous ont combattus, et de même les Amoréens, les Phéréziens, les Cananéens, les Hittites, les Guirgasiens, les Héviens et les Jébusiens, mais je vous les ai livrés.
fr.R: Puis vous avez traversé le Jourdain et vous êtes arrivés à Jéricho. Les habitants de Jéricho vous ont combattus. Les Amoréens, les Phéréziens, les Cananéens, les Hittites, les Guirgasiens, les Héviens et les Jébusiens aussi. Mais je vous ai donné la victoire sur eux tous.

vi.L: Các ngươi qua sông Giô-đanh và đến Giê-ri-cô, và những người quyền thế của Giê-ri-cô đánh các ngươi, cùng người A-mô-rít, người Phê-rê-sít, người Ca-na-an, người Hê-tít, người Ghi-rê-ga-sít, người Hê-vít và người Giê-bu-sít; và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} phó họ vào tay các ngươi.
vi.B: Rồi các ngươi qua sông Giô-đanh và đến Giê-ri-cô. Những người có quyền thế ở Giê-ri-cô đánh các ngươi, người A-mô-rít, người Phê-rê-sít, người Ca-na-an, người Hê-tít, người Ghi-rê-ga-sít, người Hê-vít và người Giê-bu-sít cũng vậy, nhưng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã phó họ vào tay các ngươi.
vi.R: Rồi các ngươi qua sông Giô-đanh và đến Giê-ri-cô. Dân Giê-ri-cô đánh các ngươi. Người A-mô-rít, người Phê-rê-sít, người Ca-na-an, người Hê-tít, người Ghi-rê-ga-sít, người Hê-vít và người Giê-bu-sít cũng vậy. Nhưng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} cho các ngươi thắng tất cả họ.

ko.L: 그리고 너희가 요단을 건너 여리고에 이르렀다. 그리고 여리고의 주민들, 곧 아모리 사람과 브리스 사람과 가나안 사람과 헷 사람과 기르가스 사람과 히위 사람과 여부스 사람이 너희와 싸웠다. 그리고 내가 그들을 너희 손에 넘겨주었다.
ko.B: 그 뒤에 너희는 요단강을 건너 여리고에 이르렀다. 여리고의 유력한 사람들이 너희와 싸웠고, 아모리 사람과 브리스 사람과 가나안 사람과 헷 사람과 기르가스 사람과 히위 사람과 여부스 사람도 그러했다. 그러나 나는 그들을 너희 손에 넘겨주었다.
ko.R: 그 뒤에 너희는 요단강을 건너 여리고에 이르렀다. 여리고 사람들이 너희와 싸웠다. 아모리 사람과 브리스 사람과 가나안 사람과 헷 사람과 기르가스 사람과 히위 사람과 여부스 사람도 그러했다. 그러나 나는 너희가 그들을 모두 이기게 했다.

pt.L: E vocês atravessaram o Jordão e chegaram a Jericó, e os senhores de Jericó lutaram contra vocês, os amorreus, e os ferezeus, e os cananeus, e os hititas, e os girgaseus, os heveus e os jebuseus; e eu os entreguei na mão de vocês.
pt.B: Depois vocês atravessaram o Jordão e chegaram a Jericó. Os cidadãos importantes de Jericó lutaram contra vocês, e também os amorreus, ferezeus, cananeus, hititas, girgaseus, heveus e jebuseus, mas eu os entreguei a vocês.
pt.R: Depois vocês atravessaram o rio Jordão e chegaram a Jericó. O povo de Jericó lutou contra vocês. Os amorreus, ferezeus, cananeus, hititas, girgaseus, heveus e jebuseus também lutaram. Mas eu deixei vocês derrotarem todos eles.

am.L: ዮርዳኖስንም ተሻግራችሁ ወደ ኢያሪኮ መጣችሁ፤ የኢያሪኮም ባለ ርስቶች፣ አሞራውያን፣ ፌርዛውያን፣ ከነዓናውያን፣ ኬጢያውያን፣ ጌርጌሳውያን፣ ኤውያውያንና ኢያቡሳውያን ተዋጓችሁ፤ በእጃችሁም አሳልፌ ሰጠኋቸው።
am.B: ከዚያም ዮርዳኖስን ተሻግራችሁ ወደ ኢያሪኮ መጣችሁ። የኢያሪኮ ታላላቅ ሰዎች ተዋጓችሁ፤ አሞራውያን፣ ፌርዛውያን፣ ከነዓናውያን፣ ኬጢያውያን፣ ጌርጌሳውያን፣ ኤውያውያንና ኢያቡሳውያንም እንዲሁ ተዋጓችሁ፤ እኔ ግን በእጃችሁ አሳልፌ ሰጠኋቸው።
am.R: ከዚያም የዮርዳኖስን ወንዝ ተሻግራችሁ ወደ ኢያሪኮ መጣችሁ። የኢያሪኮ ሰዎች ተዋጓችሁ። አሞራውያን፣ ፌርዛውያን፣ ከነዓናውያን፣ ኬጢያውያን፣ ጌርጌሳውያን፣ ኤውያውያንና ኢያቡሳውያንም እንዲሁ ተዋጓችሁ። እኔ ግን ሁሉንም ድል እንድታደርጓቸው አደረግሁ።

decisions.choice: the lords of Jericho: its leading citizens, the landowners of the city
decisions.reason: The word means "owners" or "masters", and with a town's name it means its citizens, especially those with land and power (Judges 9:2). Jericho shut its gates against Israel (6:1), and that resistance is counted here as fighting.

decisions.choice: the Amorites ... the Jebusites: all the peoples of the land, who fought after Jericho
decisions.reason: The list comes straight after "the lords of Jericho" without "and". Jericho was not a city of seven peoples, so the list sums up all who fought Israel in the land in chapters 6-12. It is the usual list of the peoples of Canaan (3:10).

decisions.choice: the leading citizens / the people of Jericho; and so did
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable state the sense of "lords" and add "and so did" to join the list to the sentence, following meaning decision m2. The Hebrew uses each people's name in the singular as a group name, so the English names are plural.

decisions.choice: "여리고의 주민들" (L); "여리고의 유력한 사람들" (B); "여리고 사람들" (R) for "the lords of Jericho"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew word means the leading citizens or landowners of the city (meaning decision m1), not its kings. Literal says "주민들" and keeps the list as one sentence; Balanced names them as the city's leading men.

decisions.choice: os senhores de Jericó (L); os cidadãos importantes de Jericó (B); o povo de Jericó (R)
decisions.reason: The word means owners or masters, with a town's name its leading citizens (m1). Literal keeps "senhores", as the English keeps "lords"; Balanced and Readable say who they were (r-en-1). The seven peoples keep the names of 3:10.

decisions.choice: "የኢያሪኮ ባለ ርስቶች" (L) / "የኢያሪኮ ታላላቅ ሰዎች" (B) / "የኢያሪኮ ሰዎች" (R) for the lords (baʿale) of Jericho
decisions.reason: The Hebrew means the city's landowning citizens; "ጌቶች" would suggest masters of slaves.

source.text: וָאֶשְׁלַ֤ח לִפְנֵיכֶם֙ אֶת־הַצִּרְעָ֔ה וַתְּגָ֤רֶשׁ אוֹתָם֙ מִפְּנֵיכֶ֔ם שְׁנֵ֖י מַלְכֵ֣י הָאֱמֹרִ֑י לֹ֥א בְחַרְבְּךָ֖ וְלֹ֥א בְקַשְׁתֶּֽךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: And I sent before you the hornet, and it drove out them from before you, two kings of the Amorites; not by your sword and not by your bow.

en.L: And I sent the hornet before you, and it drove them out from before you, the two kings of the Amorites; not by your sword and not by your bow.
en.B: I sent the hornet ahead of you, and it drove them out before you, the two Amorite kings. It was not your sword or your bow that did it.
en.R: I sent hornets ahead of you. They chased away the two kings of the Amorites. You did not win with your own swords and bows.

sw.L: Nami nikatuma mavu mbele yenu, nayo yakawafukuza mbele yenu, wale wafalme wawili wa Waamori; si kwa upanga wako wala si kwa upinde wako.
sw.B: Nilituma mavu mbele yenu, nayo yakawafukuza mbele yenu, wale wafalme wawili wa Waamori. Haikuwa kwa upanga wako wala kwa upinde wako.
sw.R: Nilituma mavu mbele yenu. Yaliwafukuza wale wafalme wawili wa Waamori. Hamkushinda kwa panga na pinde zenu wenyewe.

es.L: Y envié delante de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} el avispón, y los expulsó de delante de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, los dos reyes de los amorreos; no con {{plural_you:su espada|vuestra espada}} ni con {{plural_you:su arco|vuestro arco}}.
es.B: Envié el avispón delante de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, y los expulsó delante de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, a los dos reyes amorreos. No fue {{plural_you:su espada|vuestra espada}} ni {{plural_you:su arco|vuestro arco}} lo que lo hizo.
es.R: Envié avispones delante de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}. Ellos ahuyentaron a los dos reyes de los amorreos. No {{plural_you:ganaron|ganasteis}} con {{plural_you:sus propias espadas|vuestras propias espadas}} y arcos.

fr.L: Et j’envoyai devant vous le frelon, et il les chassa devant vous, les deux rois des Amoréens ; non par ton épée et non par ton arc.
fr.B: J’ai envoyé devant vous le frelon, et il les a chassés devant vous, les deux rois amoréens. Ce n’est pas ton épée ni ton arc qui l’ont fait.
fr.R: J’ai envoyé des frelons devant vous. Ils ont chassé les deux rois des Amoréens. Ce n’est pas avec vos épées et vos arcs que vous avez gagné.

vi.L: Ta sai ong bắp cày đi trước các ngươi, và nó đuổi họ khỏi trước mặt các ngươi, hai vua của người A-mô-rít; không phải bởi gươm các ngươi, cũng không phải bởi cung các ngươi.
vi.B: Ta sai ong bắp cày đi trước các ngươi, và nó đuổi họ đi trước mặt các ngươi, tức là hai vua A-mô-rít. Không phải gươm hay cung của các ngươi đã làm điều đó.
vi.R: Ta sai ong bắp cày đi trước các ngươi. Chúng đuổi chạy hai vua của người A-mô-rít. Các ngươi đã không thắng nhờ gươm và cung của mình.

ko.L: 그리고 내가 너희 앞에 왕벌을 보냈고, 그것이 그들, 곧 아모리 사람의 두 왕을 너희 앞에서 쫓아내었다. 너희 칼로도 아니고 너희 활로도 아니었다.
ko.B: 나는 너희보다 앞서 왕벌을 보냈고, 그것이 아모리 사람의 두 왕을 너희 앞에서 쫓아내었다. 그 일을 한 것은 너희 칼이나 너희 활이 아니었다.
ko.R: 나는 너희보다 앞서 왕벌들을 보냈다. 그 왕벌들이 아모리 사람의 두 왕을 쫓아내었다. 너희가 너희 칼과 활로 이긴 것이 아니었다.

pt.L: E enviei a vespa diante de vocês, e ela os expulsou de diante de vocês, os dois reis dos amorreus; não com a tua espada e não com o teu arco.
pt.B: Enviei a vespa à frente de vocês, e ela os expulsou da frente de vocês, os dois reis amorreus. Não foram a espada nem o arco de vocês que fizeram isso.
pt.R: Mandei vespas à frente de vocês. Elas expulsaram os dois reis dos amorreus. Vocês não venceram com as suas próprias espadas e arcos.

am.L: ተርብንም በፊታችሁ ላክሁ፤ እርሱም ሁለቱን የአሞራውያን ነገሥታት ከፊታችሁ አባረራቸው፤ በሰይፋችሁ አይደለም፤ በቀስታችሁም አይደለም።
am.B: ተርብን ከፊታችሁ ላክሁ፤ እርሱም ሁለቱን የአሞራውያን ነገሥታት ከፊታችሁ አባረራቸው። ይህን ያደረገው ሰይፋችሁ ወይም ቀስታችሁ አልነበረም።
am.R: ተርቦችን ከፊታችሁ ላክሁ። እነርሱም ሁለቱን የአሞራውያን ነገሥታት አባረሯቸው። ድል ያደረጋችሁት በራሳችሁ ሰይፍና ቀስት አልነበረም።

decisions.choice: the hornet: the meaning of the word is uncertain
decisions.reason: As in Exodus 23:28 and Deuteronomy 7:20, the only other places the word appears. It is usually taken as "hornet", a stinging insect, whether real or a picture of a terror that drives people to flight. Some take it as "panic" or "plague". Either way God himself drove the enemy out.

decisions.choice: two kings of the Amorites, as in the Hebrew text
decisions.reason: The two Amorite kings are Sihon and Og, east of the Jordan (verse 8; 2:10; 9:10). The ancient Greek translation reads "twelve kings of the Amorites", which would refer to kings west of the Jordan. The Hebrew reading is kept.

decisions.choice: not by your sword and not by your bow: the victory was God's
decisions.reason: "Your" is singular here, speaking to Israel as one. The land was not won by Israel's weapons but by God (Psalm 44:4, 7).

decisions.choice: It was not your sword or your bow that did it / You did not win with your own swords and bows
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable turn the short closing phrase into a full sentence. Readable uses "hornets" in the plural, as in Exodus 23:28, since the singular names the kind of creature.

decisions.choice: "el avispón" (L, B); "avispones" (R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew word names a stinging insect, the hornet, as in Exodus 23:28 and Deuteronomy 7:20; Spanish has the exact word. Readable makes it plural, as the English Readable does, since the Hebrew singular stands for the whole swarm.

decisions.choice: "ton épée", "ton arc" in the singular at Literal and Balanced
decisions.reason: The Hebrew turns to the singular "your", speaking to Israel as one person. French keeps the singular at Literal and Balanced; Readable says "vos", as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "왕벌" for the hornet
decisions.reason: The meaning of the Hebrew word is uncertain (meaning decision m1); Korean keeps the usual sense, the hornet, as the English does.

decisions.choice: a vespa (L, B), vespas (R); a tua espada, o teu arco (L); de vocês (B, R)
decisions.reason: "A vespa" keeps the word of Exodus 23:28 and Deuteronomy 7:20 in Portuguese, singular at Literal and Balanced and plural at Readable (m1; r-en-1). "Your" with sword and bow is singular, Israel spoken to as one (m3): Literal keeps "tua" and "teu", word by word; Balanced and Readable keep the plural of the rest of God's words, so that no sentence mixes "tu" and "vocês".

decisions.choice: "ተርብ" for the hornet, as Exodus 23:28 and Deuteronomy 7:20
decisions.reason: The wording of the Amharic Pentateuch for the same promise; the meaning of the Hebrew word is uncertain, as the meaning decision says.

source.text: וָאֶתֵּ֨ן לָכֶ֜ם אֶ֣רֶץ׀אֲשֶׁ֧ר לֹֽא־יָגַ֣עְתָּ בָּ֗הּ וְעָרִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹא־בְנִיתֶ֔ם וַתֵּשְׁב֖וּ בָּהֶ֑ם כְּרָמִ֤ים וְזֵיתִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹֽא־נְטַעְתֶּ֔ם אַתֶּ֖ם אֹכְלִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: And I gave to you a land on which not you had labored, and cities which not you had built, and you live in them; vineyards and olive groves which not you planted, you [are] eating.

en.L: And I gave you a land on which you had not labored, and cities that you had not built, and you live in them; vineyards and olive groves that you did not plant, you are eating [from them].'
en.B: I gave you a land you had not worked for and towns you had not built, and you live in them. You eat from vineyards and olive groves you did not plant.'
en.R: I gave you land that you did not work for, and towns that you did not build. Now you live in those towns. You eat grapes and olives from vines and trees you did not plant.'

sw.L: Nami nikawapa nchi ambayo hamkuitaabikia, na miji ambayo hamkuijenga, nanyi mnakaa ndani yake; mashamba ya mizabibu na mizeituni ambayo hamkuipanda, mnakula [matunda yake].'
sw.B: Niliwapa nchi ambayo hamkuifanyia kazi na miji ambayo hamkuijenga, nanyi mnaishi ndani yake. Mnakula matunda ya mashamba ya mizabibu na mizeituni ambayo hamkuipanda.'
sw.R: Niliwapa nchi ambayo hamkuifanyia kazi, na miji ambayo hamkuijenga. Sasa mnaishi katika miji hiyo. Mnakula zabibu na zeituni za mizabibu na miti ambayo hamkuipanda.'

es.L: Y {{plural_you:les|os}} di una tierra en la que no {{plural_you:habían|habíais}} trabajado, y ciudades que no {{plural_you:habían|habíais}} edificado, y {{plural_you:habitan|habitáis}} en ellas; viñas y olivares que no {{plural_you:plantaron|plantasteis}}, [de ellos] {{plural_you:comen|coméis}}”.
es.B: {{plural_you:Les|Os}} di una tierra por la que no {{plural_you:habían|habíais}} trabajado y poblaciones que no {{plural_you:habían|habíais}} construido, y {{plural_you:viven|vivís}} en ellas. {{plural_you:Comen|Coméis}} de viñas y olivares que no {{plural_you:plantaron|plantasteis}}”.
es.R: {{plural_you:Les|Os}} di una tierra que no {{plural_you:trabajaron|trabajasteis}}, y pueblos que no {{plural_you:construyeron|construisteis}}. Ahora {{plural_you:viven|vivís}} en esos pueblos. {{plural_you:Comen|Coméis}} uvas y aceitunas de viñas y árboles que no {{plural_you:plantaron|plantasteis}}”.

fr.L: Et je vous donnai un pays pour lequel vous n’aviez pas peiné, et des villes que vous n’aviez pas bâties, et vous y habitez ; des vignes et des oliviers que vous n’avez pas plantés, vous [en] mangez.”
fr.B: Je vous ai donné un pays pour lequel vous n’aviez pas travaillé et des villes que vous n’aviez pas bâties, et vous y habitez. Vous mangez les fruits de vignes et d’oliviers que vous n’avez pas plantés.”
fr.R: Je vous ai donné un pays pour lequel vous n’avez pas travaillé, et des villes que vous n’avez pas bâties. Maintenant, vous habitez dans ces villes. Vous mangez le raisin et les olives de vignes et d’arbres que vous n’avez pas plantés.”

vi.L: Ta ban cho các ngươi một xứ mà các ngươi không khó nhọc làm ra, và các thành các ngươi không xây, và các ngươi ở trong đó; các vườn nho và vườn ô-liu các ngươi không trồng, các ngươi đang ăn [trái của chúng].'
vi.B: Ta ban cho các ngươi một xứ các ngươi không khó nhọc làm ra, và những thành các ngươi không xây, và các ngươi đang ở trong đó. Các ngươi ăn trái của những vườn nho và vườn ô-liu các ngươi không trồng.'
vi.R: Ta ban cho các ngươi đất mà các ngươi không khó nhọc làm ra, và những thành các ngươi không xây. Bây giờ các ngươi sống trong những thành ấy. Các ngươi ăn nho và ô-liu từ những cây các ngươi không trồng.'

ko.L: 그리고 내가 너희가 수고하지 않은 땅과 너희가 세우지 않은 성읍들을 너희에게 주었으니, 너희가 그 안에 살고 있다. 너희가 심지 않은 포도원과 올리브 밭에서 너희가 먹고 있다.'
ko.B: 나는 너희가 일구지 않은 땅과 너희가 세우지 않은 성읍들을 너희에게 주었고, 너희는 그 안에서 살고 있다. 너희는 너희가 심지 않은 포도원과 올리브 밭에서 열매를 먹고 있다.'
ko.R: 나는 너희가 일하지 않은 땅과 너희가 세우지 않은 성읍들을 너희에게 주었다. 이제 너희는 그 성읍들에서 살고 있다. 너희는 너희가 심지 않은 포도나무와 올리브 나무에서 포도와 올리브를 따 먹고 있다.'

pt.L: E dei a vocês uma terra em que vocês não tinham trabalhado, e cidades que não tinham edificado, e vocês habitam nelas; vinhas e olivais que vocês não plantaram, [deles] vocês estão comendo.'
pt.B: Dei a vocês uma terra pela qual não tinham trabalhado e cidades que não tinham construído, e vocês moram nelas. Vocês comem de vinhas e olivais que não plantaram.'
pt.R: Dei a vocês uma terra pela qual vocês não trabalharam e cidades que vocês não construíram. Agora vocês moram nessas cidades. Vocês comem uvas e azeitonas de videiras e oliveiras que não plantaram.'

am.L: ያልደከማችሁባትን ምድር፣ ያልሠራችኋቸውንም ከተሞች ሰጠኋችሁ፤ በእነርሱም ትኖራላችሁ፤ ካልተከላችኋቸው ወይኖችና የወይራ ዛፎች ትበላላችሁ።”
am.B: ያልደከማችሁባትን ምድርና ያልሠራችኋቸውን ከተሞች ሰጠኋችሁ፤ በእነርሱም ትኖራላችሁ። ካልተከላችኋቸው የወይን ቦታዎችና የወይራ ዛፎች ትበላላችሁ።”
am.R: ያልሠራችሁበትን ምድርና ያልገነባችኋቸውን ከተሞች ሰጠኋችሁ። አሁን በእነዚያ ከተሞች ትኖራላችሁ። ካልተከላችኋቸው የወይን ተክሎችና የወይራ ዛፎች ወይንና ወይራ ትበላላችሁ።”

decisions.choice: a land you had not labored on: the promise of Deuteronomy 6:10-11 kept
decisions.reason: Moses had said God would give Israel great cities they did not build, houses they did not fill, and vineyards and olive trees they did not plant (Deuteronomy 6:10-11). God now says it has happened. The gift came before any work of theirs.

decisions.choice: you are eating: what they enjoy now
decisions.reason: The form describes something going on at the time: the people at Shechem are eating this fruit as Joshua speaks.

decisions.choice: God's words close here
decisions.reason: The single quote opened in verse 2 closes here. Joshua's own speech goes on in verse 14.

decisions.choice: grapes and olives from vines and trees
decisions.reason: Readable says what is eaten from the vineyards and olive groves.

source.text: וְעַתָּ֞ה יְר֧אוּ אֶת־יְהוָ֛ה וְעִבְד֥וּ אֹת֖וֹ בְּתָמִ֣ים וּבֶֽאֱמֶ֑ת וְהָסִ֣ירוּ אֶת־אֱלֹהִ֗ים אֲשֶׁר֩ עָבְד֨וּ אֲבוֹתֵיכֶ֜ם בְּעֵ֤בֶר הַנָּהָר֙ וּבְמִצְרַ֔יִם וְעִבְד֖וּ אֶת־יְהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And now fear Yahweh and serve him in wholeness and in faithfulness, and remove the gods which served your fathers beyond the River and in Egypt, and serve Yahweh.

en.L: And now fear {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and serve {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} in wholeness and in faithfulness, and remove the gods that your fathers served beyond the River and in Egypt, and serve {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: So now, fear {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and serve {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} with a whole heart and with faithfulness. Remove from among you the gods your ancestors served across the River and in Egypt, and serve {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: So now, have deep respect for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. Serve {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} with all your heart, and be faithful to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. Get rid of the gods your ancestors served on the other side of the Euphrates River and in Egypt. Serve {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

sw.L: Basi sasa mcheni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na kumtumikia kwa ukamilifu na kwa uaminifu, na kuiondoa miungu ambayo baba zenu waliitumikia ng'ambo ya Mto na huko Misri, mkamtumikie {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Basi sasa mcheni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na kumtumikia kwa moyo mkamilifu na kwa uaminifu. Iondoeni kati yenu miungu ambayo baba zenu waliitumikia upande wa pili wa Mto na huko Misri, mkamtumikie {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Basi sasa mheshimuni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} sana. Mtumikieni kwa moyo wenu wote, na kuwa waaminifu kwake. Iondoeni miungu ambayo babu zenu waliitumikia upande wa pili wa Mto Frati na huko Misri. Mtumikieni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

es.L: Y ahora {{plural_you:teman|temed}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} y {{plural_you:sírvanle|servidle}} con integridad y con fidelidad, y {{plural_you:quiten|quitad}} los dioses a los que sirvieron {{plural_you:sus padres|vuestros padres}} al otro lado del Río y en Egipto, y {{plural_you:sirvan|servid}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}.
es.B: Así que ahora {{plural_you:teman|temed}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} y {{plural_you:sírvanle|servidle}} con un corazón íntegro y con fidelidad. {{plural_you:Quiten|Quitad}} de en medio de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} los dioses a los que sirvieron {{plural_you:sus antepasados|vuestros antepasados}} al otro lado del Río y en Egipto, y {{plural_you:sirvan|servid}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}.
es.R: Así que ahora {{plural_you:respeten|respetad}} profundamente {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}. {{plural_you:Sírvanle|Servidle}} con todo {{plural_you:su corazón|vuestro corazón}}, y {{plural_you:sean|sed}} fieles a {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}. {{plural_you:Desháganse|Deshaceos}} de los dioses a los que sirvieron {{plural_you:sus antepasados|vuestros antepasados}} al otro lado del río Éufrates y en Egipto. {{plural_you:Sirvan|Servid}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}.

fr.L: Et maintenant, craignez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} et servez-{{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} avec intégrité et avec fidélité, et ôtez les dieux qu’ont servis vos pères au-delà du Fleuve et en Égypte, et servez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Maintenant donc, craignez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} et servez-{{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} d’un cœur entier et avec fidélité. Ôtez du milieu de vous les dieux que vos ancêtres ont servis de l’autre côté du Fleuve et en Égypte, et servez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Maintenant donc, respectez profondément {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. Servez-{{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} de tout votre cœur, et soyez-{{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} fidèles. Débarrassez-vous des dieux que vos ancêtres ont servis de l’autre côté de l’Euphrate et en Égypte. Servez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.

vi.L: Vậy bây giờ, hãy kính sợ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và phụng sự {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cách trọn vẹn và trung tín; hãy dẹp bỏ các thần mà tổ phụ anh em đã phụng sự bên kia Sông và tại Ai Cập, và hãy phụng sự {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.B: Vậy bây giờ, hãy kính sợ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và hết lòng, trung tín phụng sự {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Hãy dẹp bỏ khỏi giữa anh em các thần mà tổ tiên anh em đã phụng sự bên kia Sông và tại Ai Cập, và hãy phụng sự {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.R: Vậy bây giờ, hãy hết lòng kính sợ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. Hãy hết lòng phụng sự {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} và trung tín với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Hãy vứt bỏ các thần mà tổ tiên anh em đã thờ ở bên kia sông Ơ-phơ-rát và tại Ai Cập. Hãy phụng sự {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.

ko.L: 그러니 이제 너희는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 경외하고 온전함과 신실함으로 그분을 섬겨라. 그리고 너희 조상들이 강 건너편과 이집트에서 섬기던 신들을 치워 버리고 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 섬겨라.
ko.B: 그러니 이제 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 경외하고, 온전한 마음과 신실함으로 그분을 섬겨라. 너희 조상들이 큰 강 건너편과 이집트에서 섬기던 신들을 너희 가운데서 없애 버리고, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 섬겨라.
ko.R: 그러니 이제 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 깊이 공경하여라. 마음을 다하여 그분을 섬기고, 그분께 신실하여라. 너희 조상들이 유프라테스 강 건너편과 이집트에서 섬기던 신들을 없애 버려라. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 섬겨라.

pt.L: E agora temam {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} e sirvam a {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} com integridade e com fidelidade; e tirem os deuses que os pais de vocês serviram além do Rio e no Egito, e sirvam {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}.
pt.B: Agora, portanto, temam {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} e sirvam a {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} de todo o coração e com fidelidade. Tirem do meio de vocês os deuses que os antepassados de vocês serviram do outro lado do Rio e no Egito, e sirvam {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}.
pt.R: Por isso, agora, tenham profundo respeito {{divine_name:pelo SENHOR|por Javé}}. Sirvam a {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} de todo o coração e sejam fiéis a {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}}. Joguem fora os deuses que os antepassados de vocês serviram do outro lado do rio Eufrates e no Egito. Sirvam {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}.

am.L: አሁንም {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} ፍሩ፤ በፍጹምነትና በታማኝነትም አገልግሉት፤ አባቶቻችሁ በወንዙ ማዶና በግብፅ ያገለገሏቸውን አማልክት አስወግዱ፤ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} አገልግሉ።
am.B: ስለዚህ አሁን {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} ፍሩ፤ በቅን ልብና በታማኝነትም አገልግሉት። አባቶቻችሁ ከኤፍራጥስ ወንዝ ማዶና በግብፅ ያገለገሏቸውን አማልክት ከመካከላችሁ አስወግዱ፤ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} አገልግሉ።
am.R: ስለዚህ አሁን {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} በጥልቅ አክብሩ። በሙሉ ልባችሁ አገልግሉት፤ ለእርሱም ታማኝ ሁኑ። አባቶቻችሁ ከኤፍራጥስ ወንዝ ማዶና በግብፅ ያገለገሏቸውን አማልክት አስወግዱ። {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} አገልግሉ።

decisions.choice: and now: Joshua turns from God's story to the call it leads to
decisions.reason: "And now" draws the conclusion from verses 2-13. Joshua speaks here in his own voice again: because of all God has done, Israel must choose to serve him.

decisions.choice: fear the LORD: hold him in awe and reverence that shows in obedience
decisions.reason: To fear the LORD is not to be terrified of him but to honor him as God, and so to keep his ways (Deuteronomy 6:13; 10:12).

decisions.choice: in wholeness and in faithfulness: with an undivided heart and with loyalty
decisions.reason: The first word means whole, complete, without blemish, here a service with nothing held back. The second means what is firm and reliable: faithfulness, loyalty, truth. Together they mean serving God sincerely and staying true to him.

decisions.choice: remove the gods: the same command Jacob gave at Shechem
decisions.reason: At Shechem Jacob told his household to put away the foreign gods among them, and buried them under the oak there (Genesis 35:2-4). The people's ancestors served other gods beyond the River (verse 2), and some Israelites had served the gods of Egypt (Ezekiel 20:7-8).

decisions.choice: with a whole heart and with faithfulness / with all your heart, and be faithful; have deep respect for (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what "wholeness" means in serving God. Readable says "have deep respect for" for "fear", as Deuteronomy does, so young readers do not think of being frightened.

decisions.choice: "teman" (L, B), "respeten profundamente" (R); "con integridad y con fidelidad" (L)
decisions.reason: Literal and Balanced keep "fear", the awe and reverence owed to the LORD; Readable says "respeten profundamente", as the English Readable says "have deep respect". The pronoun joined to the verb ("sírvanle") takes no deity pronoun span, as set at 22:5; the free "a él" in Readable does.

decisions.choice: "phụng sự" for serving God and the gods, at every level; "thờ" where Readable speaks of the gods
decisions.reason: The Hebrew verb is the work of a servant and the worship of a god at once; "phụng sự" keeps the link with "đầy tớ của CHÚA" that runs through this chapter. Readable uses "thờ" for the old gods where a young reader needs to hear that worship is meant.

decisions.choice: "경외하다" (L, B); "깊이 공경하다" (R) for "fear the LORD"
decisions.reason: "Fear" here is awe and reverence that shows in obedience (meaning decision m2). "경외" carries that at Literal and Balanced; Readable says it in plainer words, as the English Readable says "have deep respect for". "두려워하다" alone would suggest terror.

decisions.choice: temam (L, B), tenham profundo respeito (R); com integridade e com fidelidade (L), de todo o coração e com fidelidade (B)
decisions.reason: "Temer" at Literal and Balanced and "ter profundo respeito" at Readable, as Deuteronomy 6:2 sets them in Portuguese (m2). The first noun is wholeness, nothing held back (m3): Literal says "integridade", Balanced "de todo o coração", as the English says "a whole heart"; the second is "fidelidade". "Tirem" is the verb Jacob uses at Shechem in Genesis 35:2 in Portuguese (m4).

decisions.choice: "ማገልገል" for ʿavad ("serve") through verses 14-24, and "በፍጹምነትና በታማኝነት" (L) / "በቅን ልብና በታማኝነት" (B) for "in wholeness and in faithfulness"
decisions.reason: The chapter turns on the one verb "serve", used of the LORD and of the gods alike; "ማገልገል" keeps it the same word each time, as Exodus 20:5 does in the Amharic.

source.text: וְאִם֩ רַ֨ע בְּֽעֵינֵיכֶ֜ם לַעֲבֹ֣ד אֶת־יְהוָ֗ה בַּחֲר֨וּ לָכֶ֣ם הַיּוֹם֮ אֶת־מִ֣י תַעֲבֹדוּן֒ אִ֣ם אֶת־אֱלֹהִ֞ים אֲשֶׁר־עָבְד֣וּ אֲבוֹתֵיכֶ֗ם אֲשֶׁר֙ מֵעֵ֣בֶרהַנָּהָ֔ר וְאִם֙ אֶת־אֱלֹהֵ֣י הָאֱמֹרִ֔י אֲשֶׁ֥ר אַתֶּ֖ם יֹשְׁבִ֣ים בְּאַרְצָ֑ם וְאָנֹכִ֣י וּבֵיתִ֔י נַעֲבֹ֖ד אֶת־יְהוָֽה׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And if [it is] evil in your eyes to serve Yahweh, choose for yourselves the day whom you will serve, whether the gods which served your fathers who [were] beyond the River, or the gods of the Amorites in whose land you [are] living; and I and my house, we will serve Yahweh.

en.L: And if it is evil in your eyes to serve {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, choose for yourselves today: whom will you serve, the gods that your fathers who [were] beyond the River served, or the gods of the Amorites in whose land you are living? But I and my house, we will serve {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}."
en.B: If serving {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} seems wrong to you, then make your choice today. Whom will you serve? The gods your ancestors served beyond the River, or the gods of the Amorites, whose land you now live in? My household and I will serve {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}."
en.R: If you do not want to serve {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, then decide today who you will serve. Will it be the gods your ancestors served on the other side of the Euphrates River? Or will it be the gods of the Amorites, the people whose land you live in now? My family and I will serve {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}."

sw.L: Na ikiwa ni uovu machoni penu kumtumikia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, jichagulieni leo: mtamtumikia nani, miungu waliyoitumikia baba zenu [walioishi] ng'ambo ya Mto, au miungu ya Waamori ambao mnaishi katika nchi yao? Ila mimi na nyumba yangu, sisi tutamtumikia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}."
sw.B: Ikiwa kumtumikia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kunaonekana vibaya kwenu, basi fanyeni uchaguzi wenu leo. Mtamtumikia nani? Miungu ambayo babu zenu waliitumikia upande wa pili wa Mto, au miungu ya Waamori ambao sasa mnaishi katika nchi yao? Mimi na watu wa nyumbani mwangu tutamtumikia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}."
sw.R: Ikiwa hamtaki kumtumikia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, basi amueni leo mtakayemtumikia. Je, itakuwa miungu ambayo babu zenu waliitumikia upande wa pili wa Mto Frati? Au itakuwa miungu ya Waamori, watu ambao sasa mnaishi katika nchi yao? Mimi na jamaa yangu tutamtumikia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}."

es.L: Y si {{plural_you:les|os}} parece mal servir {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, {{plural_you:escojan|escoged}} hoy a quién {{plural_you:servirán|serviréis}}: si a los dioses a los que sirvieron {{plural_you:sus padres|vuestros padres}}, que [estaban] al otro lado del Río, o a los dioses de los amorreos, en cuya tierra {{plural_you:habitan|habitáis}}. Pero en cuanto a mí y a mi casa, nosotros serviremos {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}».
es.B: Si {{plural_you:les|os}} parece mal servir {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, {{plural_you:elijan|elegid}} hoy. ¿A quién {{plural_you:servirán|serviréis}}? ¿A los dioses que sirvieron {{plural_you:sus antepasados|vuestros antepasados}} al otro lado del Río, o a los dioses de los amorreos, en cuya tierra {{plural_you:viven|vivís}} ahora? Mi familia y yo serviremos {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}».
es.R: Si no {{plural_you:quieren|queréis}} servir {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, entonces {{plural_you:decidan|decidid}} hoy a quién {{plural_you:van|vais}} a servir. ¿Serán los dioses a los que sirvieron {{plural_you:sus antepasados|vuestros antepasados}} al otro lado del río Éufrates? ¿O serán los dioses de los amorreos, la gente en cuya tierra {{plural_you:viven|vivís}} ahora? Mi familia y yo serviremos {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}».

fr.L: Et s’il est mal à vos yeux de servir {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, choisissez-vous aujourd’hui qui vous servirez, les dieux qu’ont servis vos pères, qui [étaient] au-delà du Fleuve, ou les dieux des Amoréens dans le pays desquels vous habitez ? decisions.choice: evil in your eyes: seems wrong or displeasing to you
decisions.reason: "Good" or "evil in someone's eyes" means what a person thinks right or wrong, pleasing or not (Genesis 28:8; Numbers 22:34).

decisions.choice: choose: the choice Joshua offers is between other gods, not between the LORD and others
decisions.reason: Joshua does not set the LORD out as one option among many. If Israel will not serve the LORD, it must still serve someone, and the only other choices are the old gods of Mesopotamia or the gods of the Canaanites around them. The challenge is meant to bring the people to choose the LORD freely and on purpose.

decisions.choice: from beyond the River, as the scribes' reading has it
decisions.reason: The written consonants (ketiv) read "in beyond the River"; the reading the scribes marked (qere) is "from beyond the River". Both describe the same gods, those served in the land beyond the Euphrates.

decisions.choice: I and my house: Joshua and his household, everyone under his care
decisions.reason: "House" here means a household, the family and all who live under its head (Genesis 18:19). The pronoun "I" comes first for emphasis: whatever others choose, Joshua has already chosen.

decisions.choice: whom will you serve ...?
decisions.reason: The Hebrew "whom you will serve, whether ... or ..." is an indirect question. All three levels turn it into a direct question, which keeps the two choices side by side and reads clearly aloud.

decisions.choice: My household and I / My family and I
decisions.reason: Balanced says "household", the closest English word for this sense of "house". Readable says "family". Both put "I" second, as English normally does; Literal keeps the Hebrew order.

decisions.choice: "Pero en cuanto a mí y a mi casa, nosotros serviremos" (L); "Mi familia y yo serviremos" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew order, which sets Joshua and his household first and then says "we will serve". Balanced and Readable say it the natural Spanish way, naming the others before oneself, and "familia" for the household, as the English says "household" and "family".

decisions.choice: "avec toute ma famille" (B), "ma famille et moi" (R); "moi et ma maison" at Literal
decisions.reason: The house is the whole household under Joshua's care. Literal keeps the Hebrew order and word; Balanced and Readable say "famille", the everyday word for a household, as the English says "household" and "family".

decisions.choice: "tôi và nhà tôi" (Literal); "gia đình tôi và tôi" (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: The house is the household, the family with all who live under Joshua's roof; Literal keeps the Hebrew word.

decisions.choice: "나와 내 집안, 우리는" (L); "나는 내 집안과 함께" (B); "나는 내 가족과 함께" (R)
alternatives: 나와 내 집은 (the wording of the older Korean Bibles)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew order, where "I and my house" stands first and "we" repeats it for weight. Balanced and Readable make Joshua the speaker who takes his household with him, which is how Korean puts a head of house and those under his care (meaning decision m4); this also keeps clear of the familiar older wording.

decisions.choice: escolham (para vocês) hoje a quem vão servir (L, B); decidam hoje a quem vão servir (R)
decisions.reason: The challenge is drafted from the Hebrew, with "vocês" and the everyday future "vão servir", not the wording of a published Portuguese Bible; Literal keeps "para vocês" for the Hebrew "for yourselves". The indirect question becomes a direct one at every level, with the two choices side by side (r-en-1).

decisions.choice: eu e a minha casa serviremos o SENHOR (L, B); Eu e a minha família vamos servir o SENHOR (R)
alternatives: nós, eu e a minha casa
decisions.reason: Portuguese puts "eu" first as the Hebrew does (m4), and it is not impolite in Portuguese, so Literal and Balanced need no change where the English Balanced moves "I" to the end (r-en-2). "A minha casa" is the Portuguese idiom for a household, everyone under one head (m4); Readable says "a minha família", as the English does.

decisions.choice: "እኔና ቤቴ ግን ... እናገለግላለን" (L) / "እኔና ቤተሰቤ ግን ... እናገለግላለን" (B) / "... የምናገለግለው {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} ነው" (R)
decisions.reason: Drafted from the Hebrew, keeping the chapter's one verb "serve" (verse 14), rather than the wording readers know from the older Amharic Bible. "ቤቴ" ("my house") at Literal; "ቤተሰቤ" ("my household") at Balanced and Readable, since the house is everyone under Joshua's care. Readable puts the LORD last for the stress the Hebrew gives him.

decisions.choice: The choice is set as a question, "ማንን ታገለግላላችሁ?", between the two kinds of gods, as the English does
decisions.reason: The meaning decision notes that Joshua offers a choice between other gods; the question form keeps the irony plain before his own answer.

decisions.choice: a profane thing for us: an exclamation rejecting something as unthinkable
decisions.reason: The word comes from the verb "to make common, profane". Said with "to us", it means "that would be an outrage for us", a strong refusal (Genesis 18:25; 44:7, 17).

decisions.choice: forsake: leave, abandon someone one belongs to
decisions.reason: The verb is used for abandoning a person or a covenant (Deuteronomy 29:24; 31:16). Joshua takes it up in verse 20.

decisions.choice: We would never / We will never
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give the force of the exclamation in plain words. The people's answer runs on to the end of verse 18.

decisions.choice: "¡Lejos esté de nosotros" (L); "¡Nunca ...!" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew calls the thought a profane thing, something unthinkable; Spanish says that with the fixed phrase "lejos esté de nosotros", as at 22:29. Balanced and Readable say it plainly, as the English does.

decisions.choice: The people speak to Joshua as "chúng tôi" and speak of the LORD as "Ngài"
decisions.reason: The people answer their leader together; of God they say "Ngài", with the deity pronoun setting, as the narrative does.

decisions.choice: The people answer Joshua in the formal polite style (합쇼체)
decisions.reason: The people speak up to their leader before God in a solemn assembly, so the formal polite style fits, as for the tribes speaking to Joshua in 17:14. Joshua keeps the plain style with them.

decisions.choice: Longe de nós (L)
decisions.reason: The exclamation (m1) is the one the eastern tribes use in 22:29, and Portuguese has a set phrase for it, "Longe de nós", so Literal uses it in both places, where the English Literal says "a profane thing" here; Balanced and Readable give the force in plain words (r-en-1).

source.text: כִּ֚י יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֔ינוּ הוּא֩ הַמַּעֲלֶ֨ה אֹתָ֧נוּ וְאֶת־אֲבוֹתֵ֛ינוּ מֵאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרַ֖יִם מִבֵּ֣ית עֲבָדִ֑ים וַאֲשֶׁ֧ר עָשָׂ֣ה לְעֵינֵ֗ינוּ אֶת־הָאֹת֤וֹת הַגְּדֹלוֹת֙ הָאֵ֔לֶּה וַֽיִּשְׁמְרֵ֗נוּ בְּכָל־הַדֶּ֨רֶךְ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הָלַ֣כְנוּ בָ֔הּ וּבְכֹל֙ הָֽעַמִּ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָבַ֖רְנוּ בְּקִרְבָּֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: For Yahweh our God, he [is] the one bringing up us and our fathers from [the] land of Egypt, from [the] house of slaves, and who did before our eyes the signs the great the these, and kept us in all the way which we went in it, and among all the peoples which we passed through their midst.

en.L: For {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} our God, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} [is] the one who brought us and our fathers up from the land of Egypt, from the house of slaves, and who did these great signs before our eyes, and kept us in all the way that we went and among all the peoples through whose midst we passed.
en.B: It is {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} our God who brought us and our ancestors up from the land of Egypt, from the house of slavery. He did these great signs before our eyes, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} kept us safe all along the road we traveled and among all the peoples we passed through.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} our God brought us and our ancestors out of Egypt, where we were slaves. We saw {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} do those great signs. He protected us everywhere we went, as we traveled through the lands of other nations.

sw.L: Kwa maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wetu, {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} [ndiye] aliyetupandisha sisi na baba zetu kutoka nchi ya Misri, kutoka nyumba ya watumwa, na aliyefanya ishara hizi kubwa mbele ya macho yetu, akatulinda katika njia yote tuliyoiendea na kati ya watu wote tuliopita katikati yao.
sw.B: Ni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wetu aliyetupandisha sisi na baba zetu kutoka nchi ya Misri, kutoka nyumba ya utumwa. Yeye alifanya ishara hizi kubwa mbele ya macho yetu, akatulinda katika njia yote tuliyosafiri na kati ya mataifa yote tuliyopita katikati yao.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wetu aliwatoa babu zetu na sisi kutoka Misri, mahali tulipokuwa watumwa. Tulimwona akifanya ishara hizo kubwa. Alitulinda kila mahali tulipokwenda, tulipokuwa tukisafiri katika nchi za mataifa mengine.

es.L: Porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} nuestro Dios, {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} [es] quien nos sacó a nosotros y a nuestros padres de la tierra de Egipto, de la casa de esclavos, y quien hizo delante de nuestros ojos estas grandes señales, y nos guardó en todo el camino por el que anduvimos y entre todos los pueblos por en medio de los cuales pasamos.
es.B: Es {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} nuestro Dios quien nos sacó a nosotros y a nuestros antepasados de la tierra de Egipto, de la casa de esclavitud. Él hizo estas grandes señales ante nuestros ojos, y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} nos protegió en todo el camino que recorrimos y entre todos los pueblos por los que pasamos.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} nuestro Dios nos sacó a nosotros y a nuestros antepasados de Egipto, donde éramos esclavos. Nosotros {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} vimos hacer esas grandes señales. Él nos protegió en todas partes, mientras viajábamos por las tierras de otras naciones.

fr.L: Car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} notre Dieu, c’est {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} qui nous a fait monter, nous et nos pères, du pays d’Égypte, de la maison des esclaves, et qui a fait devant nos yeux ces grands signes, et qui nous a gardés sur tout le chemin où nous avons marché et parmi tous les peuples au milieu desquels nous sommes passés.
fr.B: C’est {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} notre Dieu qui nous a fait monter, nous et nos ancêtres, du pays d’Égypte, de la maison où nous étions esclaves. Il a fait ces grands signes sous nos yeux, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} nous a protégés tout au long du chemin que nous avons parcouru et parmi tous les peuples que nous avons traversés.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} notre Dieu nous a fait sortir d’Égypte, nous et nos ancêtres, alors que nous étions esclaves. Nous {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}avons vu faire ces grands signes. Il nous a protégés partout où nous sommes allés, quand nous avons traversé les pays d’autres nations.

vi.L: Vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời chúng tôi, chính {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} [là] Đấng đã đem chúng tôi và tổ phụ chúng tôi lên khỏi đất Ai Cập, khỏi nhà nô lệ, Đấng đã làm những dấu lạ lớn này trước mắt chúng tôi, và gìn giữ chúng tôi trên suốt con đường chúng tôi đi, và giữa mọi dân tộc chúng tôi đã đi ngang qua.
vi.B: Chính {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời chúng tôi, đã đem chúng tôi và tổ tiên chúng tôi lên khỏi đất Ai Cập, khỏi nhà nô lệ. Ngài đã làm những dấu lạ lớn này trước mắt chúng tôi, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã gìn giữ chúng tôi suốt con đường chúng tôi đi, giữa mọi dân tộc chúng tôi đã đi qua.
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời chúng tôi, đã đem chúng tôi và tổ tiên chúng tôi ra khỏi Ai Cập, nơi chúng tôi làm nô lệ. Chúng tôi đã thấy {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} làm những dấu lạ lớn ấy. Ngài đã bảo vệ chúng tôi khắp nơi chúng tôi đi, khi chúng tôi đi qua đất của các dân tộc khác.

ko.L: 우리 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}, 그분께서 우리와 우리 조상들을 이집트 땅, 종살이하던 집에서 이끌어 올리셨고, 우리 눈앞에서 이 큰 표적들을 행하셨으며, 우리가 걸어온 모든 길에서, 그리고 우리가 그 가운데로 지나온 모든 민족 가운데서 우리를 지켜 주셨습니다.
ko.B: 우리와 우리 조상들을 이집트 땅, 종살이하던 집에서 이끌어 올리신 분은 바로 우리 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}이십니다. 그분께서는 우리 눈앞에서 이 큰 표적들을 행하셨고, 우리가 걸어온 모든 길에서, 우리가 지나온 모든 민족 가운데서 우리를 지켜 주셨습니다.
ko.R: 우리 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 우리와 우리 조상들을 이집트에서 이끌어 내셨습니다. 우리는 거기에서 종살이를 했습니다. 우리는 그분께서 큰 표적들을 행하시는 것을 보았습니다. 우리가 다른 민족들의 땅을 지나갈 때에도, 그분께서는 우리가 가는 곳마다 우리를 지켜 주셨습니다.

pt.L: Pois {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o nosso Deus, {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} [é] o que nos fez subir, a nós e aos nossos pais, da terra do Egito, da casa de escravos, e que fez diante dos nossos olhos estes grandes sinais, e nos guardou em todo o caminho em que andamos e entre todos os povos por cujo meio passamos.
pt.B: Foi {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o nosso Deus, quem nos fez subir, a nós e aos nossos antepassados, da terra do Egito, da casa da escravidão. Ele fez estes grandes sinais diante dos nossos olhos, e {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} nos protegeu durante todo o caminho que percorremos e entre todos os povos pelos quais passamos.
pt.R: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}}, o nosso Deus, tirou a nós e aos nossos antepassados do Egito, onde éramos escravos. Nós {{deity_pronoun:o|O}} vimos fazer aqueles grandes sinais. Ele nos protegeu em todo lugar por onde andamos, quando viajamos pelas terras de outras nações.

am.L: እኛንና አባቶቻችንን ከግብፅ ምድር፣ ከባሮች ቤት ያወጣን፣ እነዚህንም ታላላቅ ምልክቶች በዓይናችን ፊት ያደረገ፣ በሄድንበትም መንገድ ሁሉ፣ በመካከላቸው ባለፍንባቸውም ሕዝቦች ሁሉ መካከል የጠበቀን አምላካችን {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እርሱ ነውና።
am.B: እኛንና አባቶቻችንን ከግብፅ ምድር፣ ከባርነት ቤት ያወጣን አምላካችን {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ነው። እነዚህን ታላላቅ ምልክቶች በዓይናችን ፊት አደረገ፤ በተጓዝንበትም መንገድ ሁሉ፣ ባለፍንባቸውም ሕዝቦች ሁሉ መካከል ጠበቀን።
am.R: አምላካችን {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እኛንና አባቶቻችንን ባሪያዎች ሆነን ከኖርንበት ከግብፅ አወጣን። እነዚያን ታላላቅ ምልክቶች ሲያደርግ አየነው። በሌሎች ሕዝቦች ምድር ስናልፍ በሄድንበት ሁሉ ጠበቀን።

decisions.choice: the house of slaves: Egypt, where Israel lived as slaves
decisions.reason: The phrase comes from the opening of the Ten Commandments (Exodus 20:2; Deuteronomy 5:6). The people answer Joshua with the words of the covenant itself.

decisions.choice: he is the one who brought us up: the LORD and no other
decisions.reason: The pronoun "he" is stressed: the LORD himself, not any of the gods of verse 15, brought Israel out. The people count themselves with their ancestors among those he rescued, as God's words did in verses 5-7.

decisions.choice: signs: acts of power that show who God is
decisions.reason: The plagues and wonders in Egypt were signs, done so that Israel and Egypt would know the LORD (Exodus 10:1-2; Deuteronomy 6:22).

decisions.choice: kept us: guarded and protected us
decisions.reason: The verb means to watch over and guard, as God promised to guard Israel on the way (Exodus 23:20).

decisions.choice: house of slaves / house of slavery / where we were slaves
decisions.reason: "Slave" stays at every level here, because the point is Israel's slavery in Egypt, as the style guide sets out for Exodus 20:2.

decisions.choice: "nyumba ya watumwa" (Literal), "nyumba ya utumwa" (Balanced), "tulipokuwa watumwa" (Readable)
decisions.reason: Israel's slavery in Egypt is one of the places where the Hebrew word for slave keeps its full force at every level, as the Pentateuch note says, so Swahili uses "mtumwa" and "utumwa" here, not "mtumishi".

decisions.choice: da casa de escravos (L); da casa da escravidão (B); onde éramos escravos (R)
decisions.reason: The people answer with the words of Exodus 20:2 (m1), so each level keeps that verse's Portuguese, with "escravo" at every level for Israel's slavery in Egypt (r-en-1).

decisions.choice: "ከባሮች ቤት" (L) / "ከባርነት ቤት" (B) / "ባሪያዎች ሆነን ከኖርንበት" (R) for "the house of slaves"
decisions.reason: The wording of Exodus 20:2 and Deuteronomy 13 in the Amharic Pentateuch.

source.text: וַיְגָ֨רֶשׁ יְהוָ֜ה אֶת־כָּל־הָעַמִּ֗ים וְאֶת־הָאֱמֹרִ֛י יֹשֵׁ֥ב הָאָ֖רֶץ מִפָּנֵ֑ינוּ גַּם־אֲנַ֨חְנוּ֙ נַעֲבֹ֣ד אֶת־יְהוָ֔ה כִּי־ה֖וּא אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And drove out Yahweh all the peoples, and the Amorite living [in] the land, from before us; also we will serve Yahweh, for he [is] our God.

en.L: And {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} drove out all the peoples, and the Amorites who lived in the land, from before us. We too will serve {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, for {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} [is] our God."
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} drove out all the peoples ahead of us, including the Amorites who lived in the land. So we too will serve {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, because {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} is our God."
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} drove out all the peoples ahead of us, even the Amorites who lived in this land. So we too will serve {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, because {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} is our God."

sw.L: Na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akawafukuza mbele yetu watu wote, na Waamori waliokaa katika nchi. Sisi nasi tutamtumikia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kwa maana {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} [ndiye] Mungu wetu."
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliwafukuza mbele yetu watu wote, hata Waamori walioishi katika nchi. Kwa hiyo sisi nasi tutamtumikia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kwa sababu {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} ndiye Mungu wetu."
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliwafukuza mbele yetu watu wote, hata Waamori walioishi katika nchi hii. Kwa hiyo sisi nasi tutamtumikia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kwa sababu {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} ndiye Mungu wetu."

es.L: Y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} expulsó de delante de nosotros a todos los pueblos, y a los amorreos que habitaban la tierra. También nosotros serviremos {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, porque {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} [es] nuestro Dios».
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} expulsó delante de nosotros a todos los pueblos, también a los amorreos que vivían en la tierra. Así que nosotros también serviremos {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, porque {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} es nuestro Dios».
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} echó delante de nosotros a todos los pueblos, aun a los amorreos que vivían en esta tierra. Así que nosotros también serviremos {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, porque {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} es nuestro Dios».

fr.L: Et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a chassé tous les peuples, et les Amoréens qui habitaient le pays, devant nous. Nous aussi, nous servirons {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, car c’est {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} notre Dieu. »
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a chassé devant nous tous les peuples, y compris les Amoréens qui habitaient le pays. Nous aussi, nous servirons {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, car {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} est notre Dieu. »
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a chassé devant nous tous les peuples, même les Amoréens qui habitaient ce pays. Alors nous aussi, nous servirons {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, parce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} est notre Dieu. »

vi.L: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã đuổi mọi dân tộc, cả người A-mô-rít sống trong xứ, khỏi trước mặt chúng tôi. Chúng tôi cũng sẽ phụng sự {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} [là] Đức Chúa Trời chúng tôi."
vi.B: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã đuổi mọi dân tộc đi trước mặt chúng tôi, kể cả người A-mô-rít sống trong xứ. Vậy chúng tôi cũng sẽ phụng sự {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là Đức Chúa Trời chúng tôi."
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã đuổi mọi dân tộc đi trước mặt chúng tôi, ngay cả người A-mô-rít sống trong xứ này. Vậy chúng tôi cũng sẽ phụng sự {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là Đức Chúa Trời chúng tôi."

ko.L: 그리고 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 모든 민족과 그 땅에 사는 아모리 사람을 우리 앞에서 쫓아내셨습니다. 우리도 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 섬기겠습니다. 그분이 우리 하나님이시기 때문입니다."
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 모든 민족을, 그 땅에 살던 아모리 사람까지도 우리 앞에서 쫓아내셨습니다. 그러니 우리도 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 섬기겠습니다. 그분이 우리 하나님이시기 때문입니다."
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 모든 민족을 우리 앞에서 쫓아내셨습니다. 이 땅에 살던 아모리 사람들까지도 쫓아내셨습니다. 그러니 우리도 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 섬기겠습니다. 그분이 우리 하나님이시기 때문입니다."

pt.L: E {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} expulsou de diante de nós todos os povos, e os amorreus que habitavam na terra. Nós também serviremos {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, porque {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} [é] o nosso Deus."
pt.B: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} expulsou da nossa frente todos os povos, inclusive os amorreus que moravam na terra. Por isso nós também serviremos {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, porque {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} é o nosso Deus."
pt.R: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} expulsou todos os povos à nossa frente, até os amorreus que moravam nesta terra. Por isso nós também vamos servir {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, porque {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} é o nosso Deus."

am.L: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}ም ሕዝቦችን ሁሉ፣ በምድሪቱም የሚኖሩትን አሞራውያን ከፊታችን አባረረ፤ እኛም ደግሞ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} እናገለግላለን፤ እርሱ አምላካችን ነውና።»

decisions.choice: and the Amorites: the chief people of the land, named out of all the peoples
decisions.reason: The "and" picks out the Amorites from "all the peoples", as the people best known for living in the land (verses 8, 15). It means "and in particular" rather than a separate group.

decisions.choice: we too will serve: the people take up Joshua's own words
decisions.reason: "We too" answers Joshua's "I and my house, we will serve the LORD" (verse 15). The people join him in his choice, and the reason they give is what God has done for them.

decisions.choice: including / even
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable show the sense of the "and" (meaning decision m1). The people's answer, opened in verse 16, closes here.

records.literal_gloss: And said Joshua to the people, not you will be able to serve Yahweh, for [a] God holy he [is]; [a] God jealous he [is]; not he will forgive your transgression and your sins.

en.L: And Joshua said to the people, "You will not be able to serve {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, for a holy God [is] {{deity_pronoun:he|He}}; a jealous God [is] {{deity_pronoun:he|He}}; {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will not forgive your transgression and your sins.
en.B: Joshua said to the people, "You will not be able to serve {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, because {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} is a holy God, a jealous God; {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will not pardon your rebellion and your sins.
en.R: Joshua told the people, "You are not able to serve {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. He is a holy God. He is a jealous God, who wants you to belong only to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. He will not forgive you when you rebel against {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} and sin.

decisions.choice: you will not be able to serve the LORD: a warning that their promise is too easy
decisions.reason: Joshua is not refusing the people or telling them not to try. He warns that serving this God is not something they can take on lightly, as if he were one god among many. Their later history bears out the warning (Judges 2:11-13).

decisions.choice: a holy God: the adjective is plural, agreeing with the plural form of the word for God
decisions.reason: The word for God has a plural form, and here the adjective "holy" agrees with it, as "living" does in 1 Samuel 17:26. It still speaks of one God. Holy means set apart, wholly other and pure, so that sin cannot stand before him (Leviticus 19:2).

decisions.choice: a jealous God: a God who demands his people's loyalty for himself alone
decisions.reason: This is not petty envy but the claim of a husband on his wife's faithfulness, which will not share her with rivals. It is the reason given in the commandment against other gods (Exodus 20:5; 34:14).

decisions.choice: will not forgive your transgression and your sins: he will not let deliberate unfaithfulness pass
decisions.reason: The verb means to lift up and carry away. "Transgression" is rebellion, a breaking of faith with one's lord; "sins" are wrongs in general. Joshua does not deny that God forgives (Exodus 34:6-7); he warns that turning to other gods is a rebellion God will not treat lightly (verse 20; Exodus 23:21).

decisions.choice: rebellion (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "transgression". Balanced and Readable say "rebellion", which is the sense of the word.

decisions.choice: who wants you to belong only to him
decisions.reason: Readable explains "jealous", following meaning decision m3, because the English word usually suggests envy.

decisions.choice: "un Dios celoso"
decisions.reason: As in Exodus 20:5: the LORD's jealousy is his claim to his people's whole loyalty, not envy. Readable explains it in words, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "Đức Chúa Trời kỵ tà" for "a jealous God"
decisions.reason: "kỵ tà" is the jealousy that will not share his people with other gods, without the sense of envy that "ghen tị" carries; Readable adds what it means, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "질투하시는 하나님" for "a jealous God"
decisions.reason: A God who demands his people's loyalty for himself alone (meaning decision m3). Korean "질투" can sound petty, but it is the word Korean readers know from the Ten Commandments, and Readable adds what it means, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: um Deus santo, um Deus zeloso (every level)
decisions.reason: "Zeloso" is the word of Exodus 20:5 and Deuteronomy 4:24 in Portuguese for God's claim on his people's loyalty (m3), without the pettiness of "ciumento"; Readable adds what it means, as the English Readable does (r-en-2). "Santo" is the terms list's word (m2).

decisions.choice: a transgressão (L); a rebeldia (B); se rebelarem (R)
decisions.reason: The word is rebellion, a breaking of faith with one's lord (m4). Literal keeps "transgressão", and Balanced says "rebeldia", the word docs/pentateuch-portuguese-terms.md gives for it, as the English says "rebellion" (r-en-1).

decisions.choice: "የሚቀና አምላክ" for "a jealous God", as Exodus 20:5
decisions.reason: The wording of the Amharic Exodus; Readable adds what the jealousy means, as the English Readable does.

records.literal_gloss: If you forsake Yahweh and serve gods of foreignness, then he will turn and do harm to you and make an end of you, after that he has done good to you.

en.L: If you forsake {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and serve foreign gods, then {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will turn and do you harm and make an end of you, after {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has done you good."
en.B: If you leave {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and serve the gods of foreigners, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will turn against you. He will bring harm on you and put an end to you, after all the good {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has done you."
en.R: If you leave {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and serve the gods of other nations, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will turn against you. He has been good to you, but then {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will bring trouble on you and destroy you."

vi.L: Nếu anh em lìa bỏ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} mà phụng sự các thần ngoại bang, thì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ quay lại làm hại anh em và tiêu diệt anh em, sau khi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã làm ơn cho anh em."
vi.B: Nếu anh em lìa bỏ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} mà phụng sự các thần của dân ngoại, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ quay lại chống anh em. Ngài sẽ giáng họa trên anh em và tiêu diệt anh em, sau mọi điều tốt lành {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã làm cho anh em."
vi.R: Nếu anh em bỏ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} mà phụng sự các thần của các dân tộc khác, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ quay lại chống anh em. Ngài đã tốt với anh em, nhưng bấy giờ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ giáng tai họa trên anh em và tiêu diệt anh em."

ko.L: 너희가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 버리고 이방 신들을 섬기면, 그분께서 너희에게 복을 주신 뒤에라도 돌아서서 너희에게 재앙을 내리시고 너희를 멸하실 것이다."
ko.B: 너희가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 떠나 이방 신들을 섬기면, 그분께서는 돌아서서 너희를 치실 것이다. 그분께서 너희에게 그렇게 좋은 일을 해 주셨어도, 너희에게 재앙을 내리시고 너희를 없애 버리실 것이다."
ko.R: 너희가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 떠나 다른 민족들의 신들을 섬기면, 그분께서는 돌아서서 너희를 치실 것이다. 그분은 너희에게 좋은 일을 해 주셨지만, 그때에는 너희에게 재앙을 내리시고 너희를 멸하실 것이다."

pt.L: Se vocês abandonarem {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} e servirem deuses estrangeiros, então {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} se voltará e lhes fará mal e acabará com vocês, depois de {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} lhes ter feito bem."
pt.B: Se vocês deixarem {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} e servirem os deuses de estrangeiros, {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} se voltará contra vocês. Ele trará o mal sobre vocês e acabará com vocês, depois de todo o bem que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} lhes fez."
pt.R: Se vocês deixarem {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} e servirem os deuses de outras nações, {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} vai se voltar contra vocês. Ele tem sido bom com vocês, mas então {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} vai trazer desgraça sobre vocês e destruir vocês."

am.L: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} ብትተዉ፣ የባዕድ አማልክትንም ብታገለግሉ፣ መልካም ካደረገላችሁ በኋላ ተመልሶ ክፉ ያደርግባችኋል፤ ያጠፋችሁማል።»
am.B: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} ብትተዉና የባዕድ አማልክትን ብታገለግሉ፣ በእናንተ ላይ ይነሣል። ያን ሁሉ መልካም ነገር ካደረገላችሁ በኋላ ክፉ ነገር ያመጣባችኋል፤ ያጠፋችሁማል።»
am.R: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} ብትተዉና የሌሎች ሕዝቦችን አማልክት ብታገለግሉ፣ በእናንተ ላይ ይነሣል። እስከ አሁን መልካም አድርጎላችኋል፤ ከዚያ በኋላ ግን መከራ ያመጣባችኋል፤ ያጠፋችሁማል።»

decisions.choice: gods of foreignness: the gods of foreign peoples
decisions.reason: The phrase means gods that belong to other nations, strangers to Israel (Genesis 35:2; Deuteronomy 31:16).

decisions.choice: he will turn: he will change from doing good to doing harm
decisions.reason: "Turn" here means turn around: the God who did them good will become their enemy. Moses gave the same warning (Deuteronomy 8:19-20; 28:63).

decisions.choice: after he has done you good: his past kindness will not shield them
decisions.reason: The phrase does not mean that the harm will come later in time only. It means that God's good gifts so far, told in verses 2-13, will not protect a people who forsake him.

decisions.choice: will turn against you
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "turn against", the sense of meaning decision m2, because "turn" alone is unclear in English.

decisions.choice: "የባዕድ አማልክት" for "gods of foreignness", here and in verse 23
decisions.reason: The wording of Genesis 35:2 in the Amharic Pentateuch, where Jacob gives the same command at Shechem.

source.text: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר הָעָ֖ם אֶל־יְהוֹשֻׁ֑עַ לֹ֕א כִּ֥י אֶת־יְהוָ֖ה נַעֲבֹֽד׃

records.literal_gloss: And said the people to Joshua, no, but Yahweh we will serve.

en.L: And the people said to Joshua, "No, but {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} we will serve!"
en.B: But the people said to Joshua, "No! We will serve {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}."
en.R: But the people answered Joshua, "No! We will serve {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}."

sw.L: Na watu wakamwambia Yoshua, "Hapana, bali {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} tutamtumikia!"
sw.B: Lakini watu wakamwambia Yoshua, "Hapana! Tutamtumikia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}."
sw.R: Lakini watu wakamjibu Yoshua, "Hapana! Tutamtumikia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}."

es.L: Y el pueblo dijo a Josué: «¡No, sino que {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} serviremos!».
es.B: Pero el pueblo le dijo a Josué: «¡No! Serviremos {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}».
es.R: Pero el pueblo le respondió a Josué: «¡No! Serviremos {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}».

fr.L: Et le peuple dit à Josué : « Non, mais c’est {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} que nous servirons ! »
fr.B: Mais le peuple dit à Josué : « Non ! Nous servirons {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. »
fr.R: Mais le peuple a répondu à Josué : « Non ! Nous servirons {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. »

vi.L: Dân chúng nói với Giô-suê: "Không, nhưng chúng tôi sẽ phụng sự {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}!"
vi.B: Nhưng dân chúng nói với Giô-suê: "Không! Chúng tôi sẽ phụng sự {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}."
vi.R: Nhưng dân chúng trả lời Giô-suê: "Không! Chúng tôi sẽ phụng sự {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}."

ko.L: 그리고 백성이 여호수아에게 말했다. "아닙니다. 우리는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 섬기겠습니다!"
ko.B: 그러나 백성은 여호수아에게 말했다. "아닙니다! 우리는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 섬기겠습니다."
ko.R: 그러나 백성은 여호수아에게 대답했다. "아닙니다! 우리는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 섬기겠습니다."

pt.L: E o povo disse a Josué: "Não, mas {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} serviremos!"
pt.B: Mas o povo disse a Josué: "Não! Nós serviremos {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}."
pt.R: Mas o povo respondeu a Josué: "Não! Nós vamos servir {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}."

am.L: ሕዝቡም ኢያሱን፦ «አይደለም፤ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} እናገለግላለን እንጂ!» አሉት።
am.B: ሕዝቡ ግን ኢያሱን፦ «አይሆንም! {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} እናገለግላለን» አሉት።
am.R: ሕዝቡ ግን ለኢያሱ፦ «አይሆንም! {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} እናገለግላለን» ብለው መለሱለት።

decisions.choice: No, but the LORD we will serve: they reject Joshua's warning and repeat their promise
decisions.reason: "No" answers Joshua's "you will not be able" (verse 19). The name of the LORD is put first for emphasis: him and no other.

decisions.choice: No! We will serve the LORD.
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable leave out "but" and use the usual English order. Literal keeps the Hebrew order to show the emphasis.

source.text: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוֹשֻׁ֜עַ אֶל־הָעָ֗ם עֵדִ֤ים אַתֶּם֙ בָּכֶ֔ם כִּֽי־אַתֶּ֞ם בְּחַרְתֶּ֥ם לָכֶ֛ם אֶת־יְהוָ֖ה לַעֲבֹ֣ד אוֹת֑וֹ וַיֹּאמְר֖וּ עֵדִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: And said Joshua to the people, witnesses you [are] against yourselves that you have chosen for yourselves Yahweh to serve him. And they said, witnesses.

en.L: And Joshua said to the people, "You [are] witnesses against yourselves that you yourselves have chosen {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} for yourselves, to serve {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}." And they said, "Witnesses!"
en.B: Then Joshua said to the people, "You are your own witnesses that you have chosen {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} for yourselves and will serve {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}." They answered, "We are witnesses."
en.R: Joshua said to the people, "You have chosen {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and promised to serve {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. You yourselves are the witnesses of this. If you break your word, your own promise will speak against you." The people said, "Yes, we are witnesses."

sw.L: Na Yoshua akawaambia watu, "Ninyi [ni] mashahidi juu ya nafsi zenu kwamba ninyi wenyewe mmejichagulia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kumtumikia." Nao wakasema, "Mashahidi!"
sw.B: Ndipo Yoshua akawaambia watu, "Ninyi ni mashahidi juu yenu wenyewe kwamba mmejichagulia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na mtamtumikia." Wakajibu, "Sisi ni mashahidi."
sw.R: Yoshua akawaambia watu, "Mmemchagua {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na kuahidi kumtumikia. Ninyi wenyewe ni mashahidi wa jambo hili. Mkivunja neno lenu, ahadi yenu wenyewe itashuhudia dhidi yenu." Watu wakasema, "Ndiyo, sisi ni mashahidi."

es.L: Y dijo Josué al pueblo: «{{plural_you:Ustedes son|Vosotros sois}} testigos contra {{plural_you:ustedes mismos|vosotros mismos}} de que {{plural_you:ustedes mismos han|vosotros mismos habéis}} escogido para {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, para servirle». Y ellos dijeron: «¡Testigos!».
es.B: Entonces Josué dijo al pueblo: «{{plural_you:Ustedes son|Vosotros sois}} testigos de {{plural_you:ustedes mismos|vosotros mismos}} de que {{plural_you:han|habéis}} escogido {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} y que {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} {{plural_you:servirán|serviréis}}». Ellos respondieron: «Somos testigos».
es.R: Josué le dijo al pueblo: «{{plural_you:Ustedes han|Vosotros habéis}} escogido {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} y {{plural_you:han|habéis}} prometido servirle. {{plural_you:Ustedes mismos son|Vosotros mismos sois}} testigos de esto. Si no {{plural_you:cumplen|cumplís}} {{plural_you:su palabra|vuestra palabra}}, {{plural_you:su propia promesa|vuestra propia promesa}} hablará contra {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}». El pueblo respondió: «Sí, somos testigos».

fr.L: Et Josué dit au peuple : « Vous [êtes] témoins contre vous-mêmes que c’est vous qui vous êtes choisi {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} pour {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} servir. » Et ils dirent : « Témoins ! »
fr.B: Alors Josué dit au peuple : « Vous êtes vos propres témoins que vous avez choisi {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} pour vous, et que vous {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} servirez. » Ils répondirent : « Nous en sommes témoins. »
fr.R: Josué a dit au peuple : « Vous avez choisi {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} et vous avez promis de {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} servir. Vous en êtes vous-mêmes les témoins. Si vous ne tenez pas parole, votre propre promesse parlera contre vous. » Le peuple a dit : « Oui, nous en sommes témoins. »

vi.L: Giô-suê nói với dân chúng: "Anh em [là] nhân chứng nghịch lại chính mình rằng chính anh em đã chọn {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} cho mình, để phụng sự {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}." Họ nói: "[Chúng tôi là] nhân chứng!"
vi.B: Bấy giờ Giô-suê nói với dân chúng: "Chính anh em làm chứng cho mình rằng anh em đã chọn {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} cho mình và sẽ phụng sự {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}." Họ đáp: "Chúng tôi xin làm chứng."
vi.R: Giô-suê nói với dân chúng: "Anh em đã chọn {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và hứa phụng sự {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Chính anh em là nhân chứng cho điều này. Nếu anh em nuốt lời, chính lời hứa của anh em sẽ làm chứng nghịch lại anh em." Dân chúng đáp: "Vâng, chúng tôi xin làm chứng."

ko.L: 그리고 여호수아가 백성에게 말했다. "너희가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 택하여 그분을 섬기겠다고 한 것에 대하여 너희 자신이 너희에게 증인이다." 그리고 그들이 말했다. "증인입니다!"
ko.B: 그러자 여호수아가 백성에게 말했다. "너희가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 택하고 그분을 섬기겠다고 했으니, 너희가 바로 너희 자신의 증인이다." 그들이 대답했다. "우리가 증인입니다."
ko.R: 여호수아가 백성에게 말했다. "너희는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 택했고, 그분을 섬기겠다고 약속했다. 이 일에 대하여는 너희 자신이 증인이다. 너희가 이 말을 어기면, 너희가 한 약속이 너희를 고발할 것이다." 백성이 말했다. "그렇습니다. 우리가 증인입니다."

pt.L: E Josué disse ao povo: "Vocês [são] testemunhas contra vocês mesmos de que vocês mesmos escolheram para vocês {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, para servirem a {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}}." E eles disseram: "Testemunhas!"
pt.B: Então Josué disse ao povo: "Vocês são testemunhas contra vocês mesmos de que escolheram {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} para vocês e vão servir a {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}}." Eles responderam: "Somos testemunhas."
pt.R: Josué disse ao povo: "Vocês escolheram {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} e prometeram servir a {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}}. Vocês mesmos são testemunhas disso. Se quebrarem a palavra, a própria promessa de vocês vai falar contra vocês." O povo respondeu: "Sim, somos testemunhas."

am.L: ኢያሱም ሕዝቡን፦ «{{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} ታገለግሉት ዘንድ እናንተ ራሳችሁ ለራሳችሁ እንደ መረጣችሁ በራሳችሁ ላይ ምስክሮች ናችሁ» አላቸው። እነርሱም፦ «ምስክሮች [ነን]» አሉ።
am.B: ከዚያም ኢያሱ ሕዝቡን፦ «{{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} ለራሳችሁ እንደ መረጣችሁና እንደምታገለግሉት በራሳችሁ ላይ ምስክሮች ናችሁ» አላቸው። እነርሱም፦ «ምስክሮች ነን» ብለው መለሱ።
am.R: ኢያሱ ሕዝቡን እንዲህ አላቸው፦ «{{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} መርጣችኋል፤ ልታገለግሉትም ቃል ገብታችኋል። በዚህ ነገር ምስክሮቹ እናንተው ራሳችሁ ናችሁ። ቃላችሁን ብታፈርሱ የገዛ ቃላችሁ ይመሰክርባችኋል።» ሕዝቡም፦ «አዎን፣ ምስክሮች ነን» አሉ።

decisions.choice: witnesses against yourselves: their own word will testify if they break it
decisions.reason: A covenant was made before witnesses who could later speak against the one who broke it (Deuteronomy 31:19, 26; Ruth 4:9-11). Here the people themselves are the witnesses: if they turn away, their own promise will condemn them. In verse 27 the stone becomes a witness too.

decisions.choice: you yourselves have chosen: the choice was theirs
decisions.reason: The pronoun "you" is repeated for emphasis. Joshua had told them to choose (verse 15), and they have chosen the LORD.

decisions.choice: Witnesses: a one-word answer meaning "We are witnesses"
decisions.reason: The people reply with the single word, accepting the role Joshua gives them.

decisions.choice: We are witnesses / Yes, we are witnesses
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give the one-word answer as a full sentence.

decisions.choice: your own promise will speak against you
decisions.reason: Readable explains "against yourselves", following meaning decision m1.
