records.literal_gloss: And now remove the gods of foreignness which [are] in your midst, and incline your heart to Yahweh, [the] God of Israel.

en.L: "And now remove the foreign gods that [are] in your midst, and incline your heart to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the God of Israel."
en.B: "Then remove the foreign gods that are among you," he said, "and turn your hearts to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the God of Israel."
en.R: "Then get rid of the foreign gods you have among you," Joshua said. "Turn your hearts to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the God of Israel."

sw.L: "Basi sasa iondoeni miungu ya kigeni [iliyo] katikati yenu, na kuielekeza mioyo yenu kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa Israeli."
sw.B: "Basi iondoeni miungu ya kigeni iliyo kati yenu," akasema, "na kuielekeza mioyo yenu kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa Israeli."
sw.R: "Basi iondoeni miungu ya kigeni mliyo nayo kati yenu," Yoshua akasema. "Ielekezeni mioyo yenu kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa Israeli."

es.L: «Y ahora {{plural_you:quiten|quitad}} los dioses extranjeros que [están] en medio de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, e {{plural_you:inclinen|inclinad}} {{plural_you:su corazón|vuestro corazón}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, el Dios de Israel».
es.B: «Entonces {{plural_you:quiten|quitad}} los dioses extranjeros que hay entre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} —les dijo—, y {{plural_you:vuelvan|volved}} {{plural_you:su corazón|vuestro corazón}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, el Dios de Israel».
es.R: «Entonces {{plural_you:desháganse|deshaceos}} de los dioses extranjeros que {{plural_you:tienen|tenéis}} entre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} —dijo Josué—. {{plural_you:Vuelvan|Volved}} {{plural_you:su corazón|vuestro corazón}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, el Dios de Israel».

fr.L: « Et maintenant, ôtez les dieux étrangers qui [sont] au milieu de vous, et inclinez votre cœur vers {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, le Dieu d’Israël. »
fr.B: « Ôtez donc les dieux étrangers qui sont au milieu de vous, dit-il, et tournez votre cœur vers {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, le Dieu d’Israël. »
fr.R: « Alors débarrassez-vous des dieux étrangers que vous avez chez vous, a dit Josué. Tournez votre cœur vers {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, le Dieu d’Israël. »

vi.L: "Vậy bây giờ, hãy dẹp bỏ các thần ngoại bang [ở] giữa anh em, và hãy nghiêng lòng về {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên."
vi.B: Ông nói: "Vậy hãy dẹp bỏ các thần ngoại bang ở giữa anh em, và hãy hướng lòng về {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên."
vi.R: Giô-suê nói: "Vậy hãy vứt bỏ các thần ngoại bang anh em đang có. Hãy hướng lòng về {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên."

ko.L: "그렇다면 이제 너희 가운데 있는 이방 신들을 치워 버리고, 너희 마음을 이스라엘의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께로 기울여라."
ko.B: 여호수아가 말했다. "그렇다면 너희 가운데 있는 이방 신들을 없애 버리고, 너희 마음을 이스라엘의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께로 돌려라."
ko.R: 여호수아가 말했다. "그렇다면 너희 가운데 있는 이방 신들을 없애 버려라. 너희 마음을 이스라엘의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께로 돌려라."

pt.L: "E agora tirem os deuses estrangeiros que [estão] no meio de vocês, e inclinem o coração de vocês para {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o Deus de Israel."
pt.B: "Então tirem os deuses estrangeiros que estão no meio de vocês", disse ele, "e voltem o coração para {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o Deus de Israel."
pt.R: "Então joguem fora os deuses estrangeiros que vocês têm", disse Josué. "Voltem o coração para {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o Deus de Israel."

am.L: «አሁንም በመካከላችሁ ያሉትን የባዕድ አማልክት አስወግዱ፤ ልባችሁንም ወደ እስራኤል አምላክ {{divine_name:ወደ እግዚአብሔር|ወደ ያህዌ}} አዘንብሉ።»
am.B: «እንግዲያውስ በመካከላችሁ ያሉትን የባዕድ አማልክት አስወግዱ፤» አለ፤ «ልባችሁንም ወደ እስራኤል አምላክ {{divine_name:ወደ እግዚአብሔር|ወደ ያህዌ}} መልሱ።»
am.R: «እንግዲያውስ በመካከላችሁ ያሉትን የባዕድ አማልክት አስወግዱ፤» አለ ኢያሱ። «ልባችሁን ወደ እስራኤል አምላክ {{divine_name:ወደ እግዚአብሔር|ወደ ያህዌ}} መልሱ።»

decisions.choice: the foreign gods in your midst: images of other gods that some still kept
decisions.reason: The words suggest that some households still had images of other gods. Jacob's family gave theirs up at Shechem in the same way (Genesis 35:2-4). Choosing the LORD meant getting rid of them.

decisions.choice: incline your heart: bend your will and desire toward
decisions.reason: The heart in Hebrew is the center of thought and will, not only feeling. To incline it to the LORD is to set one's whole self toward him (1 Kings 8:58; Psalm 119:36).

decisions.choice: he said / Joshua said
decisions.reason: The Hebrew does not say again who is speaking. Balanced and Readable add it, since the people have just spoken. The Hebrew "heart" is singular, the people's heart as one; English uses "hearts".

decisions.choice: "여호수아가 말했다" placed before the quotation
decisions.reason: The English Balanced and Readable put "he said" inside the quotation. Korean does not break a quotation for the speaker, so the words naming the speaker come first.

decisions.choice: os deuses estrangeiros; o coração (singular)
decisions.reason: "Os deuses estrangeiros" and "tirem" are the words of Jacob's command at Shechem in Genesis 35:2 in Portuguese (m1). Portuguese keeps the Hebrew singular "o coração", the usual way to speak of each one's heart (as Deuteronomy 10:16 does), where the English says "hearts".

records.literal_gloss: And said the people to Joshua, Yahweh our God we will serve, and to his voice we will listen.

en.L: And the people said to Joshua, "{{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} our God we will serve, and to {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} voice we will listen."
en.B: And the people told Joshua, "It is {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} our God we will serve, and it is {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} voice we will obey."
en.R: The people answered Joshua, "We will serve {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} our God. We will do what {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} tells us."

sw.L: Na watu wakamwambia Yoshua, "{{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wetu tutamtumikia, na sauti {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} tutaisikiliza."

sw.R: Watu wakamjibu Yoshua, "Tutamtumikia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wetu. Tutafanya yale anayotuambia."

es.L: Y el pueblo dijo a Josué: «{{divine_name:Al SEÑOR|A Yahvé}} nuestro Dios serviremos, y a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} voz obedeceremos».
es.B: Y el pueblo le dijo a Josué: «Es {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} nuestro Dios a quien serviremos, y es {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} voz la que obedeceremos».
es.R: El pueblo le respondió a Josué: «Serviremos {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} nuestro Dios. Haremos lo que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} nos diga».

fr.L: Et le peuple dit à Josué : « {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} notre Dieu, nous [le] servirons, et à {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} voix nous obéirons. »
fr.B: Et le peuple dit à Josué : « C’est {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} notre Dieu que nous servirons, et c’est à {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} voix que nous obéirons. »
fr.R: Le peuple a répondu à Josué : « Nous servirons {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} notre Dieu. Nous ferons ce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} nous dira. »

vi.L: Dân chúng nói với Giô-suê: "{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời chúng tôi, chúng tôi sẽ phụng sự, và tiếng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} chúng tôi sẽ nghe theo."
vi.B: Dân chúng nói với Giô-suê: "Chính {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời chúng tôi, là Đấng chúng tôi sẽ phụng sự, và chính tiếng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là tiếng chúng tôi sẽ vâng theo."
vi.R: Dân chúng trả lời Giô-suê: "Chúng tôi sẽ phụng sự {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời chúng tôi. Chúng tôi sẽ làm theo điều {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} phán bảo."

ko.L: 그리고 백성이 여호수아에게 말했다. "우리 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 우리가 섬기고, 그분의 목소리를 우리가 듣겠습니다."
ko.B: 백성이 여호수아에게 말했다. "우리가 섬길 분은 우리 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}이시고, 우리가 순종할 것은 그분의 목소리입니다."
ko.R: 백성이 여호수아에게 대답했다. "우리는 우리 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 섬기겠습니다. 우리는 그분께서 말씀하시는 대로 하겠습니다."

pt.L: E o povo disse a Josué: "{{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}}, o nosso Deus, serviremos, e a {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} voz ouviremos."
pt.B: O povo disse a Josué: "É {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o nosso Deus, que serviremos, e é à {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} voz que obedeceremos."
pt.R: O povo respondeu a Josué: "Vamos servir {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o nosso Deus. Vamos fazer o que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} nos mandar."

decisions.choice: listen to his voice: obey him
decisions.reason: To listen to someone's voice is to do what they say (Exodus 19:5; Deuteronomy 13:5).

decisions.choice: the LORD our God ... his voice: put first for emphasis
decisions.reason: Both objects come before their verbs, stressing whom Israel will serve and obey. This is the people's third answer (verses 16-18, 21), and their fullest.

decisions.choice: It is the LORD our God we will serve, and it is his voice ...
decisions.reason: Balanced keeps the emphasis with "it is ...". Readable uses plain order.

decisions.choice: cut a covenant: make a binding agreement
decisions.reason: Hebrew speaks of "cutting" a covenant, probably from the old practice of cutting animals in two when an agreement was sworn (Genesis 15:9-18; Jeremiah 34:18).

decisions.choice: for the people: Joshua makes the covenant on their behalf, between them and God
decisions.reason: The small word can mean "with" or "for". Joshua is not making an agreement between himself and the people but leading them into a covenant with the LORD, as Moses had done (Exodus 24:3-8; Deuteronomy 29:9-14). The people have bound themselves in verses 16-24.

decisions.choice: a statute and a judgment: binding rules that set out the covenant's terms
decisions.reason: The pair names fixed law and the rulings that apply it. The same pair is used of the rule God set for Israel at Marah (Exodus 15:25). Here it means the covenant's terms, which Joshua writes down in verse 26.

decisions.choice: statute and judgment / statute and ruling / laws and rules
decisions.reason: These follow the words used for these terms throughout Numbers to Ruth. Literal keeps "cut a covenant"; Balanced and Readable say "made". Readable uses plurals and adds "to live by" to show what the rules were for.

decisions.choice: "pacto"; "estatuto y norma" (L, B), "leyes y normas" (R)
decisions.reason: As the Pentateuch terms list sets, the covenant is "el pacto", and the pair of legal words is "estatuto" and "norma"; Readable says "leyes y normas", as the English Readable says "laws and rules". The Hebrew "cut a covenant" is the usual phrase for making one, which Spanish says with "hacer un pacto".

decisions.choice: "conclut une alliance" at Literal for "cut a covenant"
decisions.reason: Hebrew "cuts" a covenant, from the animals cut in two at its making. French "trancher une alliance" is not used; the usual "conclure une alliance" keeps the sense of a binding agreement settled once for all, and serves at every level.

decisions.choice: "lập một giao ước" at every level
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says a covenant is "cut"; Vietnamese "lập" is the usual verb, and the cut has no Vietnamese counterpart even at Literal.

decisions.choice: "언약을 맺다" for "cut a covenant"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew idiom "cut a covenant" means to make a binding agreement (meaning decision m1); Korean "맺다" is the usual verb, and a word-for-word "자르다" would mislead even at Literal.

decisions.choice: cortou uma aliança (L), fez uma aliança (B, R); um estatuto e uma ordenança (L, B), leis e regras (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew picture of cutting a covenant (m1), as the English Literal does; Balanced and Readable say "fazer uma aliança". The pair of terms keeps the Portuguese of the Pentateuch's terms list and Deuteronomy 6:1: "estatuto" and "ordenança", and Readable's "leis e regras" (r-en-1). "Em favor do povo" gives the sense of "for" (m2).

source.text: וַיִּכְתֹּ֤ב יְהוֹשֻׁ֨עַ֙ אֶת־הַדְּבָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֔לֶּה בְּסֵ֖פֶר תּוֹרַ֣ת אֱלֹהִ֑ים וַיִּקַּח֙ אֶ֣בֶן גְּדוֹלָ֔ה וַיְקִימֶ֣הָ שָּׁ֔ם תַּ֚חַת הָֽאַלָּ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֖ר בְּמִקְדַּ֥שׁ יְהוָֽה׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And wrote Joshua the words the these in [the] book of [the] law of God, and he took a stone great and set it up there under the oak which [was] at [the] sanctuary of Yahweh.

en.L: And Joshua wrote these words in the book of the law of God; and he took a large stone and set it up there under the oak that [was] by the sanctuary of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: Joshua wrote these words in the book of God's law. He also took a great stone and raised it there under the oak that stood near the sanctuary of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: Joshua wrote these words in the book of God's teaching. Then he took a big stone and stood it up there under the oak tree beside the place where {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} was worshiped.

sw.L: Na Yoshua akayaandika maneno haya katika kitabu cha sheria ya Mungu; akachukua jiwe kubwa, akalisimamisha huko chini ya mwaloni [uliokuwa] karibu na mahali patakatifu pa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Yoshua aliyaandika maneno haya katika kitabu cha sheria ya Mungu. Pia alichukua jiwe kubwa akalisimamisha huko chini ya mwaloni uliokuwa karibu na mahali patakatifu pa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Yoshua aliyaandika maneno haya katika kitabu cha mafundisho ya Mungu. Kisha akachukua jiwe kubwa akalisimamisha huko chini ya mti wa mwaloni, kando ya mahali ambapo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliabudiwa.

es.L: Y Josué escribió estas palabras en el libro de la ley de Dios; y tomó una piedra grande y la levantó allí debajo de la encina que [estaba] junto al santuario {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.B: Josué escribió estas palabras en el libro de la ley de Dios. También tomó una gran piedra y la levantó allí, debajo de la encina que estaba junto al santuario {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.R: Josué escribió estas palabras en el libro de la enseñanza de Dios. Luego tomó una piedra grande y la puso de pie allí, debajo de la encina que estaba junto al lugar donde se adoraba {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}.

fr.L: Et Josué écrivit ces paroles dans le livre de la loi de Dieu ; et il prit une grande pierre et la dressa là, sous le chêne qui [était] près du sanctuaire {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Josué écrivit ces paroles dans le livre de la loi de Dieu. Il prit aussi une grande pierre et la dressa là, sous le chêne qui se trouvait près du sanctuaire {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Josué a écrit ces paroles dans le livre de l’enseignement de Dieu. Puis il a pris une grosse pierre et l’a dressée là, sous le chêne, à côté de l’endroit où l’on adorait {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.

vi.L: Giô-suê chép những lời này vào sách luật pháp của Đức Chúa Trời; rồi ông lấy một tảng đá lớn và dựng nó tại đó, dưới cây sồi [ở] bên nơi thánh của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.B: Giô-suê chép những lời này vào sách luật pháp của Đức Chúa Trời. Ông cũng lấy một tảng đá lớn dựng lên tại đó, dưới cây sồi gần nơi thánh của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.R: Giô-suê chép những lời này vào sách lời dạy của Đức Chúa Trời. Rồi ông lấy một tảng đá lớn dựng đứng tại đó, dưới cây sồi bên cạnh nơi người ta thờ phượng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.

ko.L: 그리고 여호수아가 이 말씀들을 하나님의 율법책에 기록하였다. 그리고 그가 큰 돌을 가져다가 거기 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 성소 곁에 있는 상수리나무 아래에 세웠다.
ko.B: 여호수아는 이 말씀을 하나님의 율법책에 기록했다. 그리고 큰 돌을 가져다가 거기 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 성소 근처에 있는 상수리나무 아래에 세웠다.
ko.R: 여호수아는 이 말씀을 하나님의 가르침이 담긴 책에 적었다. 그리고 큰 돌을 가져다가 거기 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 예배하던 곳 옆에 있는 상수리나무 아래에 세웠다.

pt.L: E Josué escreveu estas palavras no livro da lei de Deus; e tomou uma grande pedra e a levantou ali, debaixo do carvalho que [estava] junto ao santuário {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}.
pt.B: Josué escreveu estas palavras no livro da lei de Deus. Também tomou uma grande pedra e a ergueu ali, debaixo do carvalho que ficava perto do santuário {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}.
pt.R: Josué escreveu estas palavras no livro do ensino de Deus. Depois pegou uma pedra grande e a colocou em pé ali, debaixo do carvalho, ao lado do lugar onde {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} era adorado.

am.L: ኢያሱም እነዚህን ቃሎች በእግዚአብሔር ሕግ መጽሐፍ ጻፋቸው፤ ታላቅ ድንጋይም ወስዶ በዚያ {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔር|የያህዌ}} መቅደስ አጠገብ ባለው የባሉጥ ዛፍ ሥር አቆመው።
am.B: ኢያሱ እነዚህን ቃሎች በእግዚአብሔር ሕግ መጽሐፍ ጻፋቸው። ታላቅ ድንጋይም ወስዶ በዚያ {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔር|የያህዌ}} መቅደስ አጠገብ በቆመው የባሉጥ ዛፍ ሥር አቆመው።
am.R: ኢያሱ እነዚህን ቃሎች በእግዚአብሔር የትምህርት መጽሐፍ ጻፋቸው። ከዚያም ትልቅ ድንጋይ ወስዶ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} በሚመለክበት ስፍራ አጠገብ ባለው የባሉጥ ዛፍ ሥር አቆመው።

decisions.choice: the book of the law of God: the written instruction from God that Moses began
decisions.reason: Moses wrote the law in a book and had it kept beside the ark (Deuteronomy 31:24-26). Joshua adds the words of this covenant to that written record, so that they bind Israel as Moses' law does. "Law" here means instruction or teaching, as in 1:7-8.

decisions.choice: the oak: a great tree at Shechem, already sacred in Israel's memory
decisions.reason: The word names a large tree, an oak or terebinth. Abraham camped at the oak of Moreh at Shechem (Genesis 12:6), Jacob buried his household's foreign gods under the oak there (Genesis 35:4), and Judges 9:6 speaks of "the oak of the pillar" at Shechem, probably this stone.

decisions.choice: the sanctuary of the LORD: a holy place at Shechem
alternatives: the holy place of the LORD
decisions.reason: The word means a holy place. The tabernacle stood at Shiloh (18:1), so this is a place of worship at Shechem itself, probably where the altar of 8:30 was built, or the word may describe the holy ground around the tree.

decisions.choice: a large stone set up: a standing stone as a lasting witness
decisions.reason: Large upright stones marked covenants and memorable events (Genesis 31:44-48; Joshua 4:20-24). Verse 27 explains what this one means.

decisions.choice: God's teaching; the place where the LORD was worshiped
decisions.reason: Readable says "teaching" for "law", as in 1:7-8, and explains "sanctuary" in plain words.

decisions.choice: "상수리나무" for the oak at Shechem
decisions.reason: The English says "oak" here, and the tree is the great tree at Shechem already remembered from Genesis 35:4 (meaning decision m2); "상수리나무" is the word Korean readers know for it.

decisions.choice: o carvalho (every level)
decisions.reason: The word names a great tree, an oak or terebinth (m2), and is not the word Genesis 35:4 uses for the tree at Shechem, where Portuguese says "terebinto" at Literal; here every level says "carvalho", as the English says "oak". The torah is "a lei" (L, B) and "o ensino" (R), as 1:7.

decisions.choice: "የባሉጥ ዛፍ" for the oak
decisions.reason: The great tree at Shechem is "ባሉጥ" in the Amharic of Genesis 35:4, where Jacob buried the foreign gods under it; the same word keeps the link.

source.text: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוֹשֻׁ֜עַ אֶל־כָּל־הָעָ֗ם הִנֵּ֨ה הָאֶ֤בֶן הַזֹּאת֙ תִּֽהְיֶה־בָּ֣נוּ לְעֵדָ֔ה כִּֽי־הִ֣יא שָׁמְעָ֗ה אֵ֚ת כָּל־אִמְרֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבֶּ֖ר עִמָּ֑נוּ וְהָיְתָ֤ה בָכֶם֙ לְעֵדָ֔ה פֶּֽן־תְּכַחֲשׁ֖וּן בֵּאלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And said Joshua to all the people, see, the stone the this will be against us for a witness, for it has heard all [the] words of Yahweh which he spoke with us; and it will be against you for a witness, lest you deny your God.

en.L: And Joshua said to all the people, "Look, this stone will be a witness against us, for it has heard all the words of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} that {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} spoke with us; and it will be a witness against you, lest you deny your God."
en.B: Joshua said to all the people, "See this stone? It will stand as a witness against us, for it has heard every word {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} said to us. It will be a witness against you, so that you do not deny your God."
en.R: Joshua said to all the people, "Look at this stone. It will be a witness against us, because it has heard everything {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} said to us. It will be a witness against you, to keep you from being false to your God."

sw.L: Na Yoshua akawaambia watu wote, "Tazameni, jiwe hili litakuwa shahidi dhidi yetu, kwa maana limesikia maneno yote ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliyosema nasi; nalo litakuwa shahidi dhidi yenu, msije mkamkana Mungu wenu."
sw.B: Yoshua akawaambia watu wote, "Mnaliona jiwe hili? Litasimama kuwa shahidi dhidi yetu, kwa maana limesikia kila neno ambalo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alituambia. Litakuwa shahidi dhidi yenu, msije mkamkana Mungu wenu."
sw.R: Yoshua akawaambia watu wote, "Litazameni jiwe hili. Litakuwa shahidi dhidi yetu, kwa sababu limesikia kila kitu ambacho {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alituambia. Litakuwa shahidi dhidi yenu, ili msije mkakosa uaminifu kwa Mungu wenu."

es.L: Y dijo Josué a todo el pueblo: «{{plural_you:Miren|Mirad}}, esta piedra será testigo contra nosotros, porque ha oído todas las palabras {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} habló con nosotros; y será testigo contra {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, para que no {{plural_you:nieguen|neguéis}} a {{plural_you:su Dios|vuestro Dios}}».
es.B: Josué dijo a todo el pueblo: «¿{{plural_you:Ven|Veis}} esta piedra? Será testigo contra nosotros, porque ha oído cada palabra que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} nos ha dicho. Será testigo contra {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, para que no {{plural_you:nieguen|neguéis}} a {{plural_you:su Dios|vuestro Dios}}».
es.R: Josué le dijo a todo el pueblo: «{{plural_you:Miren|Mirad}} esta piedra. Será testigo contra nosotros, porque ha oído todo lo que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} nos dijo. Será testigo contra {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, para que no {{plural_you:sean|seáis}} infieles a {{plural_you:su Dios|vuestro Dios}}».

fr.L: Et Josué dit à tout le peuple : « Voici, cette pierre sera un témoin contre nous, car elle a entendu toutes les paroles {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a dites avec nous ; et elle sera un témoin contre vous, de peur que vous ne reniiez votre Dieu. »
fr.B: Josué dit à tout le peuple : « Voyez cette pierre ! Elle servira de témoin contre nous, car elle a entendu toutes les paroles que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} nous a dites. Elle sera un témoin contre vous, pour que vous ne reniiez pas votre Dieu. »
fr.R: Josué a dit à tout le peuple : « Regardez cette pierre. Elle sera un témoin contre nous, parce qu’elle a entendu tout ce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} nous a dit. Elle sera un témoin contre vous, pour vous empêcher d’être infidèles à votre Dieu. »

vi.L: Giô-suê nói với toàn dân: "Này, hòn đá này sẽ là nhân chứng nghịch lại chúng ta, vì nó đã nghe mọi lời của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} mà {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã phán với chúng ta; nó sẽ là nhân chứng nghịch lại anh em, kẻo anh em chối bỏ Đức Chúa Trời của mình."
vi.B: Giô-suê nói với toàn dân: "Anh em thấy hòn đá này không? Nó sẽ làm nhân chứng nghịch lại chúng ta, vì nó đã nghe mọi lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán với chúng ta. Nó sẽ làm nhân chứng nghịch lại anh em, để anh em không chối bỏ Đức Chúa Trời của mình."
vi.R: Giô-suê nói với toàn dân: "Hãy nhìn hòn đá này. Nó sẽ làm nhân chứng nghịch lại chúng ta, vì nó đã nghe mọi điều {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán với chúng ta. Nó sẽ làm nhân chứng nghịch lại anh em, để giữ anh em khỏi bất trung với Đức Chúa Trời của mình."

ko.L: 그리고 여호수아가 온 백성에게 말했다. "보아라, 이 돌이 우리에게 증거가 될 것이다. 이 돌이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 우리에게 하신 모든 말씀을 들었기 때문이다. 그리고 너희가 너희 하나님을 부인하지 않도록, 이 돌이 너희에게 증거가 될 것이다."

ko.R: 여호수아가 온 백성에게 말했다. "이 돌을 보아라. 이 돌이 우리에게 불리한 증거가 될 것이다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 우리에게 하신 말씀을 이 돌이 모두 들었기 때문이다. 너희가 너희 하나님께 거짓되이 행하지 않도록, 이 돌이 너희에게 불리한 증거가 될 것이다."

pt.L: E Josué disse a todo o povo: "Eis que esta pedra será testemunha contra nós, pois ela ouviu todas as palavras {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} falou conosco; e ela será testemunha contra vocês, para que vocês não neguem o Deus de vocês."
pt.B: Josué disse a todo o povo: "Estão vendo esta pedra? Ela será uma testemunha contra nós, pois ouviu cada palavra que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} nos disse. Ela será uma testemunha contra vocês, para que não neguem o Deus de vocês."
pt.R: Josué disse a todo o povo: "Olhem esta pedra. Ela vai ser uma testemunha contra nós, porque ouviu tudo o que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} nos disse. Ela vai ser uma testemunha contra vocês, para impedir que vocês sejam falsos com o Deus de vocês."

am.L: ኢያሱም ሕዝቡን ሁሉ እንዲህ አላቸው፦ «እነሆ፣ ይህ ድንጋይ በእኛ ላይ ምስክር ይሆናል፤ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ከእኛ ጋር የተናገረውን ቃል ሁሉ ሰምቷልና፤ አምላካችሁን እንዳትክዱም በእናንተ ላይ ምስክር ይሆናል።»
am.B: ኢያሱ ሕዝቡን ሁሉ እንዲህ አላቸው፦ «ይህን ድንጋይ ታዩታላችሁ? በእኛ ላይ ምስክር ሆኖ ይቆማል፤ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} የነገረንን ቃል ሁሉ ሰምቷልና። አምላካችሁን እንዳትክዱም በእናንተ ላይ ምስክር ይሆናል።»
am.R: ኢያሱ ሕዝቡን ሁሉ እንዲህ አላቸው፦ «ይህን ድንጋይ ተመልከቱ። በእኛ ላይ ምስክር ይሆናል፤ ምክንያቱም {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} የነገረንን ሁሉ ሰምቷል። ለአምላካችሁ ታማኝ ሳትሆኑ እንዳትቀሩ በእናንተ ላይ ምስክር ይሆናል።»

decisions.choice: it has heard: a picture of the stone as a witness who was there
decisions.reason: The stone stood where the covenant was made, so it is pictured as a witness who heard every word. In the same way Moses called heaven and earth to witness (Deuteronomy 32:1), and Jacob and Laban made a heap of stones a witness (Genesis 31:48).

decisions.choice: against us ... against you: Joshua counts himself under the covenant, then turns to the people
decisions.reason: Joshua speaks first of "us": he is bound by the covenant as well. Then he addresses the people, because they are the ones in danger of turning away (verses 19-20).

decisions.choice: deny your God: deal falsely with him, disown him
decisions.reason: The verb means to lie or deny, to act as though one does not know someone (Isaiah 59:13; Jeremiah 5:12). Here it means breaking faith with God after promising to serve him.

decisions.choice: so that you do not deny / to keep you from being false to
decisions.reason: Balanced keeps "deny"; Readable says "be false to" so the sense is plain. Both give the sense of "lest".

decisions.choice: testemunha (as 22:27, 34); neguem (L, B), sejam falsos com (R)
decisions.reason: The stone is a witness that heard every word (m1), so it takes "testemunha", the word of the altar in 22:27-34 and of the heap of stones in Genesis 31:48 in Portuguese. "Negar" is to disown, to act as if one did not know someone (m3); Readable says "ser falso com", as the English says "be false to" (r-en-1).

source.text: וַיְשַׁלַּ֤ח יְהוֹשֻׁ֨עַ֙ אֶת־הָעָ֔ם אִ֖ישׁ לְנַחֲלָתֽוֹ׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And sent away Joshua the people, each to his inheritance.

en.L: And Joshua sent the people away, {{gender:each to their|each man to his}} inheritance.
en.B: Then Joshua sent the people away, {{gender:each to their own|each man to his own}} inheritance.
en.R: Then Joshua sent the people home. Everyone went back to the land given to them.

sw.L: Na Yoshua akawaaga watu, kila mtu kwenye urithi wake.
sw.B: Kisha Yoshua akawaaga watu, kila mtu aende kwenye urithi wake mwenyewe.
sw.R: Kisha Yoshua akawaruhusu watu warudi nyumbani. Kila mmoja alirudi kwenye nchi aliyopewa.

es.L: Y Josué despidió al pueblo, cada uno a su heredad.
es.B: Luego Josué despidió al pueblo, cada uno a su propia heredad.
es.R: Luego Josué despidió al pueblo para que volviera a casa. Cada uno regresó a la tierra que le había tocado.

fr.L: Et Josué renvoya le peuple, chacun à son héritage.
fr.B: Puis Josué renvoya le peuple, chacun dans son héritage.
fr.R: Puis Josué a renvoyé le peuple chez lui. Chacun est retourné sur la terre qu’il avait reçue.

vi.L: Giô-suê cho dân chúng ra về, ai nấy về sản nghiệp của mình.
vi.B: Rồi Giô-suê cho dân chúng ra về, ai nấy về sản nghiệp riêng của mình.
vi.R: Rồi Giô-suê cho dân chúng về nhà. Mọi người trở về phần đất đã được ban cho mình.

ko.L: 그리고 여호수아가 백성을 각각 자기 유산으로 보냈다.
ko.B: 그러고 나서 여호수아는 백성을 저마다 자기 유산으로 돌려보냈다.
ko.R: 그러고 나서 여호수아는 백성을 집으로 돌려보냈다. 그들은 저마다 자기가 받은 땅으로 돌아갔다.

pt.L: E Josué despediu o povo, cada um para a sua herança.
pt.B: Então Josué despediu o povo, cada um para a sua própria herança.
pt.R: Depois Josué mandou o povo para casa. Todos voltaram para a terra que tinham recebido.

am.L: ኢያሱም ሕዝቡን እያንዳንዱን ወደ ርስቱ አሰናበተ።
am.B: ከዚያም ኢያሱ ሕዝቡን እያንዳንዱን ወደ ገዛ ርስቱ አሰናበተ።
am.R: ከዚያም ኢያሱ ሕዝቡን ወደ ቤታቸው አሰናበተ። እያንዳንዱም ወደ ተሰጠው ምድር ተመለሰ።

decisions.choice: inheritance: each family's allotted share of the land
decisions.reason: The land was divided among the tribes and families in chapters 13-21. The covenant made, the people go back to live on the land God gave them. Judges 2:6 takes up the story in the same words.

decisions.choice: each to their / each man to his
decisions.reason: The Hebrew word is "man" in the sense of "each one", and the whole people, men and women, went home. The default is inclusive; the traditional setting keeps "each man". Readable's "everyone" needs no setting.

decisions.choice: "cada uno a su heredad" with no gender span
decisions.reason: The English puts "each to their" / "each man to his" under the gender setting. Spanish "cada uno" already takes in everyone, and "su" has no gender, so Spanish has no second wording for the setting to change.

decisions.choice: no gender setting for "chacun à son héritage"
decisions.reason: The English needs a setting for "each to their / each man to his". French "chacun" already means everyone, and "son" agrees with the thing owned, so the French has one natural wording, as the style guide sets for generic pronouns.

decisions.choice: "ai nấy" for "each to their / each man to his", with no gender span
decisions.reason: "ai nấy" means everyone, men and women alike, so the English choice has no Vietnamese counterpart.

decisions.choice: "각각", "저마다" with no gender span
decisions.reason: Korean "저마다" and "각각" take in every person without a pronoun, so the gender setting the English uses here has nothing to change in Korean.

decisions.choice: cada um, with no gender setting
decisions.reason: The Hebrew "man" means each one, men and women (r-en-1). Portuguese "cada um" already includes everyone and is the ordinary wording, so there is nothing for the English gender setting to change; "cada homem" would be wrong rather than traditional.

decisions.choice: "እያንዳንዱን ወደ ርስቱ" with no gender span
alternatives: a gender span as in the English
decisions.reason: "እያንዳንዱ" already means each one, man or woman, and Amharic speaks of such a person with the ordinary masculine forms, so there is no second wording for the setting to switch to.

source.text: וַיְהִ֗י אַֽחֲרֵי֙ הַדְּבָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֔לֶּה וַיָּ֛מָת יְהוֹשֻׁ֥עַ בִּן־נ֖וּן עֶ֣בֶד יְהוָ֑ה בֶּן־מֵאָ֥ה וָעֶ֖שֶׂר שָׁנִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: And it was after the things the these, and died Joshua son of Nun, [the] servant of Yahweh, a son of a hundred and ten years.

en.L: And it came about after these things that Joshua son of Nun, the slave of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, died, a son of 110 years.
en.B: After these events, Joshua son of Nun, the servant of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, died, at 110 years of age.
en.R: Some time after this, Joshua son of Nun died. He was the servant of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and he was 110 years old.

sw.L: Na ikawa baada ya mambo haya, Yoshua mwana wa Nuni, mtumishi wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, akafa, mwana wa miaka 110.
sw.B: Baada ya matukio hayo, Yoshua mwana wa Nuni, mtumishi wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, alikufa akiwa na umri wa miaka 110.
sw.R: Muda fulani baada ya hayo, Yoshua mwana wa Nuni alikufa. Yeye alikuwa mtumishi wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, naye alikuwa na umri wa miaka 110.

es.L: Y sucedió después de estas cosas que murió Josué hijo de Nun, siervo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, siendo de ciento diez años.
es.B: Después de estos sucesos murió Josué hijo de Nun, el siervo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, a la edad de ciento diez años.
es.R: Algún tiempo después murió Josué hijo de Nun. Él era el siervo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, y tenía ciento diez años.

fr.L: Et il arriva, après ces choses, que Josué fils de Noun, le serviteur {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, mourut, âgé de cent dix ans.
fr.B: Après ces événements, Josué fils de Noun, le serviteur {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, mourut à l’âge de cent dix ans.
fr.R: Quelque temps plus tard, Josué fils de Noun est mort. Il était le serviteur {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, et il avait cent dix ans.

vi.L: Sau các việc này, Giô-suê con trai Nun, đầy tớ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, qua đời, hưởng thọ 110 tuổi.
vi.B: Sau các việc ấy, Giô-suê con trai Nun, đầy tớ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, qua đời, thọ 110 tuổi.
vi.R: Một thời gian sau đó, Giô-suê con trai Nun qua đời. Ông là đầy tớ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, và ông được 110 tuổi.

ko.L: 그리고 이 일들 뒤에 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 종 눈의 아들 여호수아가 죽었으니, 백십 세였다.
ko.B: 이 일들이 있은 뒤에 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 종 눈의 아들 여호수아가 죽었다. 그의 나이는 백십 세였다.
ko.R: 얼마 뒤에 눈의 아들 여호수아가 죽었다. 그는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 종이었고, 그때 나이가 백십 세였다.

pt.L: E aconteceu, depois destas coisas, que Josué, filho de Num, o escravo {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, morreu, filho de cento e dez anos.
pt.B: Depois destes acontecimentos, Josué, filho de Num, o servo {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, morreu com cento e dez anos de idade.
pt.R: Algum tempo depois disso, Josué, filho de Num, morreu. Ele era o servo {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} e tinha cento e dez anos.

am.L: ከዚህም ነገር በኋላ እንዲህ ሆነ፤ {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔር|የያህዌ}} ባሪያ የነዌ ልጅ ኢያሱ የ110 ዓመት ልጅ ሆኖ ሞተ።
am.B: ከዚህ ሁሉ በኋላ {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔር|የያህዌ}} አገልጋይ የነዌ ልጅ ኢያሱ በ110 ዓመቱ ሞተ።
am.R: ከዚህ በኋላ ጥቂት ቆይቶ የነዌ ልጅ ኢያሱ ሞተ። እርሱ {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔር|የያህዌ}} አገልጋይ ነበረ፤ ዕድሜውም 110 ዓመት ነበረ።

decisions.choice: the servant of the LORD: the title given to Moses, now given to Joshua at his death
decisions.reason: The word for "servant" is the word for a slave, a person who belonged wholly to a master. Said of a man and God it is a title of honor. The book opened by calling Moses "the servant of the LORD" and Joshua "Moses' attendant" (1:1). Only now, at the end of his life, is Joshua given Moses' title.

decisions.choice: a son of 110 years: 110 years old
decisions.reason: Hebrew gives a person's age as being a "son of" so many years.

decisions.choice: 110 years: the age at which Joseph died
decisions.reason: Joseph died at 110 (Genesis 50:26), and his bones are buried in verse 32. Judges 2:8 repeats this notice of Joshua's death.

decisions.choice: slave (Literal) / servant (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: The title follows the usual rule, as for Moses in 1:1: Literal shows the hard sense of the word, and Balanced and Readable use "servant" for this title of honor.

decisions.choice: "mtumishi wa BWANA" at Literal too
decisions.reason: As at 13:8: the title of Moses and Joshua is "mtumishi" at every level in Swahili, where the English Literal says "slave".

decisions.choice: "siervo del SEÑOR" for Joshua at every level; "ciento diez años" in words
decisions.reason: Joshua now bears the title given to Moses (1:1; 13:8), and Spanish keeps "siervo" at every level, as the terms note sets. Spanish writes the age in words, as Spanish prose does for a number this size; the meaning is the same as the English figures.

decisions.choice: "le serviteur du SEIGNEUR" at every level for Joshua at his death
decisions.reason: The meaning decision notes that Moses' title is now given to Joshua. French gives it the same form the terms note sets for Moses, "serviteur" at every level, so that the reader sees it is the same title; the English Literal has "slave".

decisions.choice: "주의 종" for Joshua at his death, at every level
decisions.reason: Joshua now receives the title given to Moses (meaning decision m1); Korean uses the same words, "주의 종", as for Moses in 13:8, so the reader hears the title passed on.

decisions.choice: o escravo do SENHOR (L), o servo do SENHOR (B, R); filho de 110 anos (L)
decisions.reason: Joshua now receives Moses' title (m1), in the words 1:1 sets for it in Portuguese: "escravo" at Literal and "servo" at Balanced and Readable. Literal keeps the Hebrew "filho de 110 anos" (m2), as Deuteronomy 31:2 does in Portuguese; Balanced and Readable give the age plainly.

decisions.choice: "የ110 ዓመት ልጅ" keeps the Hebrew "a son of 110 years" at Literal
decisions.reason: As the Literal of Deuteronomy 31:2 in the Amharic Pentateuch.

source.text: וַיִּקְבְּר֤וּ אֹתוֹ֙ בִּגְב֣וּל נַחֲלָת֔וֹ בְּתִמְנַת־סֶ֖רַח אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּהַר־אֶפְרָ֑יִם מִצְּפ֖וֹן לְהַר־גָּֽעַשׁ׃

records.literal_gloss: And they buried him in [the] territory of his inheritance at Timnath-serah, which [is] in [the] hill country of Ephraim, from [the] north of [the] mountain of Gaash.

en.L: And they buried him in the territory of his inheritance at Timnath-serah, which [is] in the hill country of Ephraim, north of the mountain of Gaash.
en.B: They buried him within the borders of his own inheritance, at Timnath-serah, north of Mount Gaash in the hill country of Ephraim.
en.R: He was buried on his own land at Timnath-serah. It is in the hill country of Ephraim, north of Mount Gaash.

sw.L: Nao wakamzika katika mpaka wa urithi wake huko Timnath-sera, ulio katika nchi ya milima ya Efraimu, kaskazini mwa mlima Gaashi.
sw.B: Walimzika ndani ya mipaka ya urithi wake mwenyewe, huko Timnath-sera, kaskazini mwa Mlima Gaashi katika nchi ya milima ya Efraimu.
sw.R: Alizikwa katika nchi yake mwenyewe huko Timnath-sera. Mji huo uko katika nchi ya milima ya Efraimu, kaskazini mwa Mlima Gaashi.

es.L: Y lo sepultaron en el territorio de su heredad en Timnat-sera, que [está] en la región montañosa de Efraín, al norte del monte de Gaas.
es.B: Lo sepultaron dentro de los límites de su propia heredad, en Timnat-sera, al norte del monte Gaas, en la región montañosa de Efraín.
es.R: Lo sepultaron en su propia tierra, en Timnat-sera. Está en la región montañosa de Efraín, al norte del monte Gaas.

fr.L: Et on l’enterra dans le territoire de son héritage, à Timnath-Sérah, qui [est] dans la montagne d’Éphraïm, au nord de la montagne de Gaash.
fr.B: On l’enterra dans les limites de son héritage, à Timnath-Sérah, au nord du mont Gaash, dans la région montagneuse d’Éphraïm.
fr.R: On l’a enterré sur sa propre terre, à Timnath-Sérah. C’est dans la région montagneuse d’Éphraïm, au nord du mont Gaash.

vi.L: Người ta chôn ông trong địa phận sản nghiệp của ông tại Thim-nát-Sê-rách, [ở] trong miền núi Ép-ra-im, phía bắc núi Ga-ách.
vi.B: Người ta chôn ông trong ranh giới sản nghiệp của ông, tại Thim-nát-Sê-rách, phía bắc núi Ga-ách trong miền núi Ép-ra-im.
vi.R: Ông được chôn trên đất của mình tại Thim-nát-Sê-rách. Nơi ấy ở trong miền núi Ép-ra-im, phía bắc núi Ga-ách.

ko.L: 그리고 그들이 그를 가아스 산 북쪽, 에브라임 산지에 있는 딤낫 세라, 곧 그의 유산의 지역에 묻었다.
ko.B: 사람들은 그를 그의 유산의 경계 안, 에브라임 산지의 가아스 산 북쪽에 있는 딤낫 세라에 묻었다.
ko.R: 그는 자기 땅인 딤낫 세라에 묻혔다. 그곳은 에브라임 산지에 있고, 가아스 산 북쪽에 있다.

pt.L: E o sepultaram no território da sua herança, em Timnate-Sera, que [está] na região montanhosa de Efraim, ao norte do monte Gaás.
pt.B: Eles o sepultaram dentro dos limites da sua própria herança, em Timnate-Sera, ao norte do monte Gaás, na região montanhosa de Efraim.
pt.R: Ele foi sepultado na sua própria terra, em Timnate-Sera. Esse lugar fica na região montanhosa de Efraim, ao norte do monte Gaás.

am.L: በርስቱ ድንበርም በኤፍሬም ኮረብታማ አገር ከገዓስ ተራራ በሰሜን ባለችው በተምናሴራ ቀበሩት።
am.B: በኤፍሬም ኮረብታማ አገር ከገዓስ ተራራ በስተ ሰሜን ባለችው በተምናሴራ፣ በገዛ ርስቱ ክልል ውስጥ ቀበሩት።
am.R: በገዛ መሬቱ በተምናሴራ ተቀበረ። ይህችም ከተማ በኤፍሬም ኮረብታማ አገር ከገዓስ ተራራ በስተ ሰሜን ትገኛለች።

decisions.choice: the territory of his inheritance at Timnath-serah: the town Joshua asked for and was given
decisions.reason: When the land had been divided, the Israelites gave Joshua the town he asked for, Timnath-serah in the hill country of Ephraim, and he rebuilt it and lived there (19:49-50). Judges 2:9 spells the name Timnath-heres, with two letters of the second part reversed.

decisions.choice: the hill country of Ephraim; Mount Gaash: Joshua's own tribe's land
decisions.reason: Joshua was from the tribe of Ephraim (Numbers 13:8). Mount Gaash is a hill whose exact site is not known; the brooks of Gaash are mentioned in 2 Samuel 23:30.

decisions.choice: He was buried
decisions.reason: Readable puts the sentence in the passive. "They" in the Hebrew means the people in general, not any group named before.

decisions.choice: Timnate-Sera; o monte Gaás
decisions.reason: For the whole book (also 19:50): the names follow the Brazilian pattern for compound names, with a hyphen and a final "-e" after t, as "Quiriate-Jearim" in 9:17; "Gaás" with the stress Portuguese gives the Hebrew name. Judges 2:9 has a different spelling of the town (m1), which this verse does not follow.

decisions.choice: "ተምናሴራ" for Timnath-serah and "ገዓስ" for Gaash
decisions.reason: Proper names in a common Ethiopian form; the lead should check them against Joshua 19:50 in the Amharic.

source.text: וַיַּעֲבֹ֤ד יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אֶת־יְהוָ֔ה כֹּ֖ל יְמֵ֣י יְהוֹשֻׁ֑עַ וְכֹ֣ל׀יְמֵ֣י הַזְּקֵנִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר הֶאֱרִ֤יכוּ יָמִים֙ אַחֲרֵ֣י יְהוֹשֻׁ֔עַ וַאֲשֶׁ֣ר יָדְע֗וּ אֵ֚ת כָּל־מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה יְהוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשָׂ֖ה לְיִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: And served Israel Yahweh all [the] days of Joshua and all [the] days of the elders who prolonged days after Joshua, and who knew all [the] work of Yahweh which he did for Israel.

en.L: And Israel served {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} all the days of Joshua and all the days of the elders who prolonged days after Joshua and who knew all the work of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} that {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} had done for Israel.
en.B: Israel served {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} all through Joshua's lifetime, and through the lifetime of the elders who lived on after him and had known for themselves every work that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had done for Israel.
en.R: The people of Israel served {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} as long as Joshua was alive. They kept serving {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} while the elders who lived longer than Joshua were still alive. These leaders had seen for themselves everything {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had done for Israel.

sw.L: Na Israeli wakamtumikia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} siku zote za Yoshua na siku zote za wazee walioishi siku nyingi baada ya Yoshua na walioijua kazi yote ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliyowafanyia Israeli.
sw.B: Israeli walimtumikia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} katika maisha yote ya Yoshua, na katika maisha ya wazee walioishi baada yake, waliokuwa wameijua wenyewe kila kazi ambayo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alikuwa amewafanyia Israeli.
sw.R: Watu wa Israeli walimtumikia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} muda wote Yoshua alipokuwa hai. Waliendelea kumtumikia wakati wazee walioishi muda mrefu kuliko Yoshua walipokuwa bado hai. Viongozi hao walikuwa wameona wenyewe kila kitu ambacho {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alikuwa amewafanyia Israeli.

es.L: Y sirvió Israel {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} todos los días de Josué, y todos los días de los ancianos que prolongaron [sus] días después de Josué y que conocían toda la obra {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} había hecho por Israel.
es.B: Israel sirvió {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} durante toda la vida de Josué, y durante la vida de los ancianos que vivieron más que él y que habían conocido por sí mismos todas las obras que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} había hecho por Israel.
es.R: El pueblo de Israel sirvió {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} mientras Josué vivió. Siguieron sirviéndole mientras vivieron los ancianos que vivieron más que Josué. Esos jefes habían visto por sí mismos todo lo que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} había hecho por Israel.

fr.L: Et Israël servit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} tous les jours de Josué, et tous les jours des anciens qui prolongèrent leurs jours après Josué et qui connaissaient toute l’œuvre que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} avait faite pour Israël.
fr.B: Israël servit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} pendant toute la vie de Josué, et pendant toute la vie des anciens qui lui survécurent et qui avaient connu par eux-mêmes toute l’œuvre que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} avait faite pour Israël.
fr.R: Le peuple d’Israël a servi {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} tant que Josué était vivant. Il a continué à {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} servir tant que vivaient les anciens qui avaient survécu à Josué. Ces chefs avaient vu de leurs propres yeux tout ce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} avait fait pour Israël.

vi.L: Y-sơ-ra-ên phụng sự {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} trọn đời Giô-suê và trọn đời các trưởng lão sống lâu hơn Giô-suê, là những người đã biết mọi công việc của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} mà {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã làm cho Y-sơ-ra-ên.
vi.B: Y-sơ-ra-ên phụng sự {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} suốt đời Giô-suê, và suốt đời các trưởng lão còn sống sau ông, là những người đã tự mình biết mọi công việc {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã làm cho Y-sơ-ra-ên.
vi.R: Dân Y-sơ-ra-ên phụng sự {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} suốt thời gian Giô-suê còn sống. Họ tiếp tục phụng sự {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} trong khi các trưởng lão sống lâu hơn Giô-suê vẫn còn sống. Những người lãnh đạo ấy đã tận mắt thấy mọi điều {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã làm cho Y-sơ-ra-ên.

ko.L: 그리고 이스라엘이 여호수아의 모든 날과, 여호수아 뒤에 오래 살아서 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이스라엘을 위하여 하신 모든 일을 아는 장로들의 모든 날 동안 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 섬겼다.
ko.B: 이스라엘은 여호수아가 사는 동안 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 섬겼고, 여호수아보다 오래 살면서 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이스라엘을 위하여 하신 모든 일을 직접 겪어 안 장로들이 사는 동안에도 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 섬겼다.
ko.R: 이스라엘 백성은 여호수아가 살아 있는 동안 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 섬겼다. 여호수아보다 오래 산 장로들이 살아 있는 동안에도 계속 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 섬겼다. 그 장로들은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이스라엘을 위하여 하신 모든 일을 자기 눈으로 본 사람들이었다.

pt.L: E Israel serviu {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} todos os dias de Josué e todos os dias dos anciãos que prolongaram [os seus] dias depois de Josué e que conheciam toda a obra {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} tinha feito por Israel.
pt.B: Israel serviu {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} durante toda a vida de Josué e durante toda a vida dos anciãos que viveram mais do que ele e que tinham conhecido por si mesmos todas as obras que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} tinha feito por Israel.
pt.R: O povo de Israel serviu {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} enquanto Josué estava vivo. E continuou servindo a {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} enquanto estavam vivos os anciãos que viveram mais tempo do que Josué. Esses líderes tinham visto com os próprios olhos tudo o que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} tinha feito por Israel.

am.L: እስራኤልም በኢያሱ ዘመን ሁሉ፣ ከኢያሱም በኋላ ዕድሜያቸው በረዘመ፣ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ለእስራኤል ያደረገውን ሥራ ሁሉ ባወቁ ሽማግሌዎች ዘመን ሁሉ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} አገለገሉ።
am.B: እስራኤል በኢያሱ ዕድሜ ሁሉ፣ ከእርሱም በኋላ በሕይወት በቆዩትና {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ለእስራኤል ያደረገውን ሥራ ሁሉ በገዛ ራሳቸው ባወቁት ሽማግሌዎች ዕድሜ ሁሉ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} አገለገሉ።
am.R: ኢያሱ በሕይወት እስካለ ድረስ የእስራኤል ሕዝብ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} አገለገሉ። ከኢያሱ በኋላ የኖሩት ሽማግሌዎች በሕይወት እስካሉም ድረስ እርሱን ማገልገላቸውን ቀጠሉ። እነዚህ መሪዎች {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ለእስራኤል ያደረገውን ሁሉ በዓይናቸው አይተው ነበር።

decisions.choice: prolonged days after Joshua: lived on after Joshua died
decisions.reason: To "lengthen days" is to live long (Deuteronomy 4:26). These elders outlived Joshua.

decisions.choice: knew: had known by their own experience
decisions.reason: To "know" God's work here means to have lived through it and seen it, not only to have heard of it (Deuteronomy 11:2-7).

decisions.choice: Israel served the LORD: the people kept the promise while that generation lived
decisions.reason: The people's promise to serve the LORD (verses 18, 21, 24) was kept as long as those who had seen his work were alive. Judges 2:7, 10 repeats this verse and goes on: the next generation did not know the LORD or his work, and served other gods.

decisions.choice: through Joshua's lifetime / as long as Joshua was alive
decisions.reason: "All the days of" someone means as long as they lived. Balanced and Readable say so in plain words.

source.text: וְאֶת־עַצְמ֣וֹת י֠וֹסֵף אֲשֶׁר־הֶעֱל֨וּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֥ל׀מִמִּצְרַיִם֮ קָבְר֣וּ בִשְׁכֶם֒ בְּחֶלְקַ֣ת הַשָּׂדֶ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר קָנָ֧ה יַעֲקֹ֛ב מֵאֵ֛ת בְּנֵֽי־חֲמ֥וֹר אֲבִֽי־שְׁכֶ֖ם בְּמֵאָ֣ה קְשִׂיטָ֑ה וַיִּֽהְי֥וּ לִבְנֵֽי־יוֹסֵ֖ף לְנַחֲלָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And [the] bones of Joseph which brought up [the] sons of Israel from Egypt they buried at Shechem, in [the] portion of the field which bought Jacob from [the] sons of Hamor, [the] father of Shechem, for a hundred qesitah; and they became for [the] sons of Joseph an inheritance.

en.L: And the bones of Joseph, which the {{gender:children|sons}} of Israel had brought up from Egypt, they buried at Shechem, in the plot of the field that Jacob had bought from the sons of Hamor, the father of Shechem, for a hundred qesitahs; and they became an inheritance of the {{gender:children|sons}} of Joseph.
en.B: The bones of Joseph, which the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} had brought up from Egypt, were buried at Shechem, in the piece of ground that Jacob had bought from the sons of Hamor, Shechem's father, paying a hundred pieces of silver. It became part of the inheritance of Joseph's descendants.
en.R: The {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} had brought Joseph's bones with them from Egypt. They buried them at Shechem, on the land Jacob had bought from the sons of Hamor, the father of Shechem. Jacob had paid a hundred pieces of silver for it. This land became part of the land that belonged to Joseph's descendants.

sw.L: Na mifupa ya Yusufu, ambayo wana wa Israeli walikuwa wameipandisha kutoka Misri, waliizika huko Shekemu, katika kipande cha shamba ambacho Yakobo alikuwa amekinunua kutoka kwa wana wa Hamori, baba wa Shekemu, kwa kesita mia moja; nacho kikawa urithi wa wana wa Yusufu.
sw.B: Mifupa ya Yusufu, ambayo Waisraeli walikuwa wameipandisha kutoka Misri, ilizikwa huko Shekemu, katika kipande cha ardhi ambacho Yakobo alikuwa amekinunua kutoka kwa wana wa Hamori, baba wa Shekemu, kwa vipande mia moja vya fedha. Kikawa sehemu ya urithi wa wazao wa Yusufu.
sw.R: Waisraeli walikuwa wameichukua pamoja nao mifupa ya Yusufu kutoka Misri. Waliizika huko Shekemu, katika ardhi ambayo Yakobo alikuwa ameinunua kutoka kwa wana wa Hamori, baba wa Shekemu. Yakobo alikuwa amelipa vipande mia moja vya fedha kwa ajili yake. Ardhi hiyo ikawa sehemu ya nchi iliyokuwa ya wazao wa Yusufu.

es.L: Y los huesos de José, que los hijos de Israel habían traído de Egipto, los sepultaron en Siquem, en la parcela del campo que Jacob había comprado a los hijos de Hamor, padre de Siquem, por cien qesitas; y vinieron a ser heredad de los hijos de José.
es.B: Los huesos de José, que los israelitas habían traído de Egipto, fueron sepultados en Siquem, en el terreno que Jacob había comprado a los hijos de Hamor, padre de Siquem, por cien monedas de plata. Ese terreno pasó a ser parte de la heredad de los descendientes de José.
es.R: Los israelitas habían traído consigo de Egipto los huesos de José. Los sepultaron en Siquem, en el terreno que Jacob había comprado a los hijos de Hamor, el padre de Siquem. Jacob había pagado cien monedas de plata por él. Ese terreno pasó a ser parte de la tierra de los descendientes de José.

fr.L: Et les os de Joseph, que les {{gender:enfants|fils}} d’Israël avaient fait monter d’Égypte, ils les enterrèrent à Sichem, dans la parcelle de champ que Jacob avait achetée aux fils de Hamor, père de Sichem, pour cent qesitas ; et elle devint l’héritage des {{gender:enfants|fils}} de Joseph.
fr.B: Les os de Joseph, que les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}} avaient emportés d’Égypte, furent enterrés à Sichem, dans le terrain que Jacob avait acheté aux fils de Hamor, père de Sichem, pour cent pièces d’argent. Ce terrain fit partie de l’héritage des descendants de Joseph.
fr.R: Les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}} avaient emporté avec eux d’Égypte les os de Joseph. Ils les ont enterrés à Sichem, sur le terrain que Jacob avait acheté aux fils de Hamor, le père de Sichem. Jacob l’avait payé cent pièces d’argent. Ce terrain a fait partie du pays qui appartenait aux descendants de Joseph.

vi.L: Hài cốt Giô-sép mà con cháu Y-sơ-ra-ên đã đem lên từ Ai Cập, họ chôn tại Si-chem, trong phần đất ruộng mà Gia-cốp đã mua của các con trai Hê-mô, cha của Si-chem, với giá một trăm kê-si-ta; và nơi ấy trở thành sản nghiệp của con cháu Giô-sép.
vi.B: Hài cốt Giô-sép mà dân Y-sơ-ra-ên đã đem lên từ Ai Cập được chôn tại Si-chem, trong miếng đất Gia-cốp đã mua của các con trai Hê-mô, cha của Si-chem, trả một trăm miếng bạc. Miếng đất ấy trở thành một phần sản nghiệp của con cháu Giô-sép.
vi.R: Dân Y-sơ-ra-ên đã đem hài cốt Giô-sép theo từ Ai Cập. Họ chôn hài cốt ấy tại Si-chem, trên miếng đất Gia-cốp đã mua của các con trai Hê-mô, cha của Si-chem. Gia-cốp đã trả một trăm miếng bạc để mua đất ấy. Miếng đất này trở thành một phần đất thuộc về con cháu Giô-sép.

ko.L: 그리고 이스라엘 자손이 이집트에서 가지고 올라온 요셉의 뼈를 세겜에 묻었으니, 그곳은 야곱이 세겜의 아버지 하몰의 아들들에게서 크시타 백 [개]에 산 밭의 한 부분이다. 그리고 그것이 요셉 자손의 유산이 되었다.
ko.B: 이스라엘 자손이 이집트에서 가지고 올라온 요셉의 뼈는 세겜에 묻혔다. 그곳은 야곱이 세겜의 아버지 하몰의 아들들에게서 은 백 조각을 주고 산 땅이었다. 그 땅은 요셉 자손의 유산이 되었다.
ko.R: 이스라엘 백성은 요셉의 뼈를 이집트에서 가지고 왔다. 그들은 그 뼈를 세겜에 묻었는데, 그곳은 야곱이 세겜의 아버지 하몰의 아들들에게서 산 땅이었다. 야곱은 그 땅값으로 은 백 조각을 치렀다. 그 땅은 요셉 자손이 받은 땅의 일부가 되었다.

pt.L: E os ossos de José, que os filhos de Israel tinham feito subir do Egito, eles os sepultaram em Siquém, na parte do campo que Jacó tinha comprado dos filhos de Hamor, pai de Siquém, por cem quesitas; e eles se tornaram herança dos filhos de José.
pt.B: Os ossos de José, que os israelitas tinham trazido do Egito, foram sepultados em Siquém, no pedaço de terra que Jacó tinha comprado dos filhos de Hamor, pai de Siquém, pagando cem peças de prata. Esse terreno passou a fazer parte da herança dos descendentes de José.
pt.R: Os israelitas tinham trazido do Egito os ossos de José. Eles os sepultaram em Siquém, no terreno que Jacó tinha comprado dos filhos de Hamor, o pai de Siquém. Jacó tinha pagado cem peças de prata por ele. Esse terreno passou a fazer parte da terra que pertencia aos descendentes de José.

decisions.choice: the bones of Joseph: the oath Joseph made his family swear
decisions.reason: Before he died, Joseph made the sons of Israel swear to carry his bones up from Egypt when God brought them out (Genesis 50:24-25). Moses took the bones with him (Exodus 13:19), and now they are buried in the promised land.

decisions.choice: the plot Jacob bought from the sons of Hamor: the field near Shechem of Genesis 33:19
decisions.reason: Jacob bought this field when he came back from Haran (Genesis 33:18-20). Hamor was the ruler of the town, and his son Shechem had the same name as the town (Genesis 34:2).

decisions.choice: qesitah: a unit of money of unknown value
decisions.reason: As in Genesis 33:19, the only other place besides Job 42:11 where the word appears. Its weight or value is not known, so no modern equivalent can be given.

decisions.choice: they became an inheritance: the plot, with the grave, belonged to Joseph's descendants
decisions.reason: The verb is plural, most likely thinking of the field and the burial together. Shechem lay in the land of Ephraim and Manasseh, Joseph's two sons (17:7).

decisions.choice: a hundred pieces of silver
decisions.reason: As in Genesis 33:19, Balanced and Readable use a general phrase for the unknown coin or weight, with no units setting; Literal keeps the Hebrew name. Balanced and Readable say "it" for the plural "they", meaning the land.

decisions.choice: were buried / They buried them
decisions.reason: The Hebrew puts "the bones of Joseph" first. Balanced keeps them first by using the passive; Readable puts the events in time order.

decisions.choice: "cien qesitas" (L); "cien monedas de plata" (B, R)
decisions.reason: As in Genesis 33:19: Literal keeps the Hebrew name of the unknown coin or weight; Balanced and Readable use a general phrase, with no units setting, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "cent qesitas" (L), "cent pièces d'argent" (B, R)
decisions.reason: As in Genesis 33:19: the qesitah was a unit of money of unknown value. Literal keeps the Hebrew word, Balanced and Readable say "pièces d'argent"; no units setting, as the English has none.

decisions.choice: "một trăm kê-si-ta" (Literal); "một trăm miếng bạc" (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: As Genesis 33:19 renders the same sale; the weight of the qesitah is not known, so it takes no units setting.

decisions.choice: "크시타 백 [개]" (L); "은 백 조각" (B, R)
decisions.reason: As in Genesis 33:19, the same purchase: the qesitah is a unit of money of unknown value (meaning decision m3), so Literal keeps the Hebrew word and Balanced and Readable say "pieces of silver", with no units span since no modern value can be given.

decisions.choice: a parte do campo ... por cem quesitas (L); o pedaço de terra ... cem peças de prata (B, R)
decisions.reason: The plot is the one of Genesis 33:19 (m2), so each level keeps that verse's Portuguese: Literal "a parte do campo" and "cem quesitas", the unknown unit spelled as Portuguese writes the sounds (m3), and Balanced and Readable "o pedaço de terra" / "o terreno" and "cem peças de prata", with no units setting, as the English (r-en-1). Balanced and Readable say "esse terreno" for the plural "they" (m4).

decisions.choice: os ossos de José; tinham feito subir (L), tinham trazido (B, R); os filhos de Israel (L), no gender setting
decisions.reason: The verse closes the oath of Genesis 50:25 and Exodus 13:19 (m1), and keeps their Portuguese words "os ossos de José" and "os filhos de Israel" (L), "os israelitas" (B, R); "filhos" already includes daughters, so the English gender setting has nothing to change, as at 7:1. Literal keeps the Hebrew "fazer subir" (brought up).

decisions.choice: "ቅሢጣ" (L) / "የብር ቁራጭ" (B, R) for the qesitah, with no units span
decisions.reason: As Genesis 33:19 in the Amharic Pentateuch, where Jacob buys the same plot: the coin's value is unknown, so there is no metric or wage form to give.

decisions.choice: Eleazar son of Aaron: the high priest who shared the leadership with Joshua
decisions.reason: Eleazar became high priest when Aaron died (Numbers 20:25-28), and he and Joshua divided the land among the tribes (14:1; 19:51). The book ends with three burials, Joshua, Joseph and Eleazar, each in the promised land.

decisions.choice: Gibeah of Phinehas: a town named for Phinehas, or the hill belonging to him
decisions.reason: The word means "hill", and it is also the name of several towns. Here it can be read as a place called "Gibeah of Phinehas" or as "the hill of Phinehas". Either way it was land given to Phinehas, though priests received towns rather than a tribal share (21:1-19).

decisions.choice: the book ends here, as in the Hebrew text
decisions.reason: The ancient Greek translation adds a few sentences after this verse: that the Israelites carried the ark about with them, that Phinehas served as priest, and that the people turned to worship other gods and were handed over to Eglon king of Moab. These lead into the story of Judges and are not in the Hebrew text.

decisions.choice: too / also; the hill town of his son Phinehas; to Phinehas
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable add "too" and "also" to link Eleazar's death with Joshua's, explain "Gibeah", and say that "him" means Phinehas.

decisions.choice: Gibeá de Fineias (L); Gibeá, a cidade na colina do seu filho Fineias (B, R)
decisions.reason: The word means "hill" and is also a town name (m2). Portuguese follows the English: the name "Gibeá", the Brazilian form, at every level, explained as a town on a hill at Balanced and Readable (r-en-1). "Fineias" and "Eleazar, filho de Arão" as Numbers 25:7 and 22:13 here.
